name: llAbs

params.name: val
params.description: Integer to convert.

description: Returns the absolute (positive) integer value of val.

name: llAcos

params.name: val
params.description: A number in the range [-1.0, 1.0].

description: Returns the arccosine of val in radians.

name: llAddToLandBanList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar to add to the ban list.

params.name: hours
params.description: Duration, in hours, to ban the avatar for (0 for indefinite).

description: Adds the avatar to the parcel ban list for the specified number of hours. A value of 0 hours adds the avatar indefinitely. Banned users teleporting to the parcel are redirected to a neighboring parcel; the minimum accepted duration is 0.01 hours (approximately 36 seconds).

name: llAddToLandPassList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar to add to the pass list.

params.name: hours
params.description: Duration, in hours, to allow the avatar for (range [0.0, 144.0], 0 for indefinite).

description: Adds the avatar to the land pass list for the specified number of hours (or indefinitely if hours is 0).

name: llAdjustDamage

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the damage event to modify.

params.name: new_damage
params.description: New damage value to be applied or distributed after on_damage processing.

description: Modifies the amount of damage applied by the current on_damage event after it completes processing, specified by the damage event index number.

name: llAdjustSoundVolume

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

description: Adjusts the volume of the currently playing attached sound (has no effect on sounds started with llTriggerSound).

name: llAgentInExperience

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region to query.

description: Returns TRUE if the specified agent is in the experience and the experience can run in the current region/location; returns FALSE otherwise.

name: llAllowInventoryDrop

params.name: add
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, allows anyone to drop inventory items into the prim (even without modify rights). If FALSE, restricts inventory dropping to those with modify permissions.

description: If add is TRUE, allows users without object modify permissions to drop inventory items into the prim. If FALSE, restricts inventory dropping to users with modify permissions.

name: llAngleBetween

params.name: start_rot
params.description: Starting rotation.

params.name: end_rot
params.description: Ending rotation.

description: Returns the angle, in radians, between rotations start_rot and and end_rot.

name: llApplyImpulse

params.name: momentum
params.description: Linear impulse vector to apply.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, momentum is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, it is treated as a global region vector.

description: Applies a linear impulse (momentum) to a physical object. If local is TRUE, the impulse is applied in local coordinates; otherwise, it is applied in global region coordinates.

name: llApplyRotationalImpulse

params.name: force
params.description: Rotational impulse vector to apply.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, the force is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, it is treated as a global region vector.

description: Applies a rotational impulse (force) to a physical object. If local is TRUE, the rotational impulse is applied in local coordinates; otherwise, it is applied in global region coordinates.

name: llAsin

params.name: val
params.description: A number in the range [-1.0, 1.0].

description: Returns the arcsine of val in radians.

name: llAtan2

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinate.

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinate.

description: Returns the arctangent of y/x in radians, using the signs to determine the quadrant. Note the argument order: Y is the first parameter, X is the second parameter.

name: llAttachToAvatar

params.name: attach_point
params.description: ATTACH_* constant or integer value representing the target attachment point.

description: Attaches the object to the avatar who has granted the PERMISSION_ATTACH permission. Takes the object into the user's inventory and attaches it at attach_point.

name: llAttachToAvatarTemp

params.name: attach_point
params.description: ATTACH_* constant or integer value representing the target attachment point.

description: Attaches the object temporarily to an avatar who has granted the PERMISSION_ATTACH permission. No permanent inventory is created, and the object disappears on detach or disconnect. Can be used on non-owners (changing ownership to the wearer).

name: llAvatarOnLinkSitTarget

params.name: link
params.description: Index of the prim in the linkset (1 for root, >1 for children), or a LINK_* flag.

description: Returns the UUID of the avatar seated on the specified link's sit target, or NULL_KEY if no avatar is sitting there.

name: llAvatarOnSitTarget
description: Returns the UUID of the avatar seated on the prim's sit target (defined via llSitTarget), or NULL_KEY if no avatar is sitting there or the prim lacks a sit target.

name: llAxes2Rot

params.name: fwd
params.description: Forward/back directional vector of the rotation.

params.name: left
params.description: Left/right directional vector of the rotation.

params.name: up
params.description: Up/down directional vector of the rotation.

description: Returns the rotation defined by the coordinate axes fwd, left, and up.

name: llAxisAngle2Rot

params.name: axis
params.description: Axis vector to rotate around.

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle to rotate, in radians.

description: Returns the rotation that rotates angle radians around the axis vector.

name: llBase64ToInteger

params.name: str
params.description: Base64-encoded string to decode.

description: Returns an integer representing the Base64-decoded big-endian value of str. Returns zero if str is longer than 8 characters; the return value is unpredictable if str contains fewer than 6 characters.

name: llBase64ToString

params.name: str
params.description: Base64-encoded string to decode.

description: Decodes the Base64-encoded string str into a conventional string, interpreting the bytes as a UTF-8 character sequence. Unprintable characters are converted to question marks.

name: llBreakAllLinks
description: Delinks all prims in the linkset. Requires the PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS runtime permission, which must be requested and granted by the owner.

name: llBreakLink

params.name: link
params.description: The link number (0: unlinked, 1: root prim, >1: child prims and seated avatars) to delink.

description: Delinks the prim specified by the link number link. Requires the PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS runtime permission.

name: llCastRay

params.name: start_pos
params.description: Starting location vector of the ray.

params.name: end_pos
params.description: Ending location vector of the ray.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of option flags and their parameters to configure the raycast.

description: Casts a ray into the physics world from start to end and reports collision data for intersections with objects based on options. Returns a list of strided values [UUID_1, {link_number_1}, hit_position_1, {hit_normal_1}, ..., status_code]. A negative status_code indicates an error; otherwise, it represents the number of hits.

name: llCeil

params.name: val
params.description: Number to round up.

description: Returns val rounded toward positive infinity. In other words, returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to val.

name: llChar

params.name: val
params.description: Unicode codepoint integer (ordinal) to convert.

description: Constructs and returns a single-character string from the given Unicode codepoint ordinal.

name: llClearCameraParams
description: Resets all camera parameters to default values and turns off scripted camera control. Requires the PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA runtime permission (automatically granted for attached or sat-on objects).

name: llClearLinkMedia

params.name: link
params.description: The link number (0: unlinked, 1: root prim, >1: child prims) or a LINK_* flag representing the target prim.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number to clear.

description: Deletes the media and clears all parameters from the given face on the linked prim. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing the success or failure of the operation.

name: llClearPrimMedia

params.name: face
params.description: Face number (side) to clear.

description: Deletes the media and clears all parameters from the specified face. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing the success or failure of the operation.

name: llCloseRemoteDataChannel

params.name: channel
params.description: XML-RPC channel ID to close.

description: Deprecated. Closes the specified XML-RPC channel.

name: llCloud

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a float representing the cloud density at the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llCollisionFilter

params.name: name
params.description: Specific object name or avatar legacy name to filter for.

params.name: id
params.description: Group, avatar, or object UUID to filter by.

params.name: accept
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, only collisions matching the name and id filters are processed; if FALSE, matching collisions are excluded.

description: Sets the collision filter, either exclusively or inclusively. If accept is TRUE, only collisions matching name and id are processed; if FALSE, matches are excluded. Pass an empty string or NULL_KEY to name or id to skip filtering on that parameter.

name: llCollisionSound

params.name: impact_sound
params.description: UUID of a sound, the name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or an empty string to suppress sounds.

params.name: impact_volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

description: Suppresses default collision sounds and replaces default impact sounds with impact_sound at the volume level specified by impact_volume. Supply an empty string to only suppress collision sounds.

name: llCollisionSprite

params.name: impact_sprite
params.description: UUID of a texture, the name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or an empty string to suppress sprites.

description: Suppresses default collision sprites and replaces them with impact_sprite (which must be in the prim's inventory). Supply an empty string to only suppress collision sprites.

name: llComputeHash

params.name: message
params.description: Message string to be hashed.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use (e.g., md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512).

description: Returns a hex-encoded hash digest string of message using the specified cryptographic algorithm.

name: llCos

params.name: theta
params.description: Angle in radians.

description: Returns the cosine of theta. Theta is in radians.

name: llCreateCharacter

params.name: options
params.description: A list of key-value pairs specifying the character's configuration options.

description: Converts the linkset containing the script into a pathfinding character entity (required to use pathfinding functions) using the specified options.

name: llCreateKeyValue

params.name: k
params.description: Unique key name for the key-value pair.

params.name: v
params.description: Value for the key-value pair (maximum 2047 characters, or 4095 characters if using Mono).

description: Starts an asynchronous transaction to create a key-value pair (k and v) associated with the script's experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_STORAGE_EXCEPTION if the key already exists.

name: llCreateLink

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target prim/object in the same region.

params.name: parent
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, the script's object becomes the root prim; if FALSE, target becomes the root.

description: Attempts to link the object containing the script with target. Requires the PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS runtime permission.

name: llCSV2List

params.name: src
params.description: String of comma-separated values to parse.

description: Parses the comma-separated string src and returns it as a list.

name: llDamage

params.name: target
params.description: Key of the target avatar or task to receive damage.

params.name: damage
params.description: Amount of damage to inflict (can exceed 100, unlike collision-based damage).

params.name: damage_type
params.description: Type of damage to deliver to the target (can correspond to a DAMAGE_TYPE_* constant).

description: Generates a damage event delivering the specified amount of damage and damage_type to the targeted avatar or task in the same region.

name: llDataSizeKeyValue
description: Starts an asynchronous transaction to request the used and total data storage allocated for the experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

name: llDeleteCharacter
description: Converts the linkset back to a standard physical object, removing all pathfinding properties.

name: llDeleteKeyValue

params.name: k
params.description: Key of the key-value pair to delete.

description: Starts an asynchronous transaction to delete the key-value pair associated with key k in the experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

name: llDeleteSubList

params.name: src
params.description: Source list to copy and modify.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Starting index of the slice to remove (inclusive).

params.name: end_index
params.description: Ending index of the slice to remove (inclusive).

description: Returns a copy of the list src with the slice from start_index to end_index (inclusive) removed. Negative indices count backward from the end of the list. If start_index is greater than end_index, the deletion excludes the specified range.

name: llDeleteSubString

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to modify.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Starting codepoint index of the substring to remove (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

params.name: end_index
params.description: Ending codepoint index of the substring to remove (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

description: Returns a copy of the string src with the characters from start_index to end_index (inclusive) removed. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string. If start_index is greater than end_index, the deletion excludes the specified range.

name: llDerezObject

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the object in the region to derez.

params.name: flags
params.description: Derez behavior flags matching DEREZ_* constants.

description: Derezzes (deletes or returns) a targeted object in the region previously rezzed by a script in this linkset, returning TRUE on success or FALSE on failure.

name: llDetachFromAvatar
description: Detaches the object containing the script from the avatar. Requires the PERMISSION_ATTACH runtime permission (automatically granted to attached objects). Note that the detached object is completely removed from the region and not dropped on the ground.

name: llDetectedDamage

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns a list containing pending damage information for the event specified by number, including the current damage, the damage type, and the original damage delivered.

name: llDetectedGrab

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns a vector representing the grab offset of the user touching the object. Only works in touch events and returns <0.0, 0.0, 0.0> if number is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedGroup

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns TRUE if the detected object or avatar specified by number has the same active group as the prim containing the script. Returns FALSE if the group is not active or if they are not in the group.

name: llDetectedKey

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the detected object or avatar specified by number, or NULL_KEY if number is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedLinkNumber

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the link number (integer) of the triggered event (touches and collisions only) specified by number. Returns 0 for non-linked objects, 1 for the root prim, and 2+ for child prims. Returns 0 if not supported by the event.

name: llDetectedName

params.name: item
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns a string representing the name of the detected object or avatar specified by item. Returns an empty string if item is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedOwner

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the owner of the detected object specified by number. Returns an invalid key if number is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedPos

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the vector position (in region coordinates) of the detected object or avatar specified by number, or <0.0, 0.0, 0.0> if number is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedRezzer

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the object or avatar that rezzed the detected object specified by number.

name: llDetectedRot

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the rotation of the detected object or avatar specified by number, or <0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0> if number is not a valid offset index.

name: llDetectedTouchBinormal

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the surface binormal vector (tangent to the surface, pointing along the positive T (V) direction of tangent space) at the touched location specified by index. Can be used with llDetectedTouchNormal to determine the tangent space.

name: llDetectedTouchFace

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the integer index of the face clicked by the avatar in the touch event specified by index.

name: llDetectedTouchNormal

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the surface normal vector (perpendicular to the surface) at the touched location specified by index. Can be used with llDetectedTouchBinormal to determine the tangent space.

name: llDetectedTouchPos

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the vector position where the object was touched (specified by index) in region coordinates, or in screen-space coordinates if the object is attached as a HUD.

name: llDetectedTouchST

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the surface coordinates (<s, t, 0.0>) where the prim was touched, specified by index. X and Y contain the horizontal (s) and vertical (t) face coordinates, typically in the interval [0.0, 1.0]. Returns TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD if coordinates cannot be determined.

name: llDetectedTouchUV

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the texture coordinates (<u, v, 0.0>) where the prim was touched, specified by index. X and Y contain the horizontal (u) and vertical (v) texture coordinates, typically in the interval [0.0, 1.0] (affected by repeats and rotation). Returns TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD if coordinates cannot be determined.

name: llDetectedType

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns an integer bitfield representing the types (AGENT, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED) of the detected object or avatar specified by number. Returns 0 if number is not a valid index.

name: llDetectedVel

params.name: number
params.description: Index of the detection information.

description: Returns the vector velocity of the detected object or avatar specified by number, or <0.0, 0.0, 0.0> if number is not a valid offset index.

name: llDialog

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message to display in the dialog box.

params.name: buttons
params.description: A list of up to 12 strings representing button labels.

params.name: channel
params.description: Output chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) where button clicks are chatted.

description: Shows a dialog box on the screen of the specified agent, displaying msg along with up to 12 choice buttons. Clicking a button chats its label on channel. The chat originates at the object's position, but uses the agent's name and UUID, so it can be heard as long as the agent is still in the region.

name: llDie
description: Deletes the entire object containing the script (the object does not go to inventory). Use llBreakLink first to delete only a single prim.

name: llDumpList2String

params.name: src
params.description: Source list to convert.

params.name: separator
params.description: Separator string to place between list entries.

description: Returns a string that is the list src converted to a single string, with separator placed between each entry.

name: llEdgeOfWorld

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

params.name: dir
params.description: Direction vector.

description: Checks if the border reached along the vector dir from the vector pos is the edge of the world (i.e., has no neighboring simulator). Returns TRUE if it hits the edge of the world, or FALSE if there is a neighboring simulator.

name: llEjectFromLand

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Ejects the specified avatar from land/parcels owned by the object's owner (group or resident).

name: llEmail

params.name: address
params.description: Destination email address.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: msg
params.description: Message body of the email.

description: Sends an email with the given destination address, subject, and body msg. The email will be sent from `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`. This can be used for script communication; see llGetNextEmail()

name: llEscapeURL

params.name: url
params.description: Unescaped URL string to escape.

description: Returns a string representing the escaped/encoded version of url, replacing spaces with '%20' and non-alphanumeric characters with their '%xx' hexadecimal UTF-8 equivalent.

name: llEuler2Rot

params.name: vec
params.description: Vector of Euler angles to convert, in radians.

description: Returns the quaternion representation of the Euler angles (in radians) within vec.

name: llEvade

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to evade.

params.name: options
params.description: No options currently available (should be empty list).

description: Directs a pathfinding character to evade target, attempting to hide from its pursuer if a hiding spot is available (i.e., no line of sight from the character's head to the pursuer's head, and no direct path on the navmesh).

name: llExecCharacterCmd

params.name: command
params.description: Pathfinding command to execute.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options for the command (e.g., jump height for CHARACTER_CMD_JUMP).

description: Sends a command (specified by command) to the pathing system with options. Currently only supports stopping pathfinding or making the character jump.

name: llFabs

params.name: val
params.description: Number to convert.

description: Returns the absolute (positive) value of val.

name: llFindNotecardTextCount

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to control the search (currently unused, should be []).

description: Asynchronously requests the number of matches of pattern in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

name: llFindNotecardTextSync

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first match to return.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of matches to return (if 0, returns the first 64 matches).

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to control the search (currently unused, should be []).

description: Synchronously searches the notecard name in the region's cache for matches of pattern, without raising a dataserver event. Returns a strided list of the form [line, column, length, ...] with one stride per match, a list containing NAK if the notecard is not cached, or an empty list if there are no matches.

name: llFleeFrom

params.name: position
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates from which to flee.

params.name: distance
params.description: Distance in meters to keep from the position.

params.name: options
params.description: No options currently available (should be empty list).

description: Directs a pathfinding character to keep the specified distance from the target position vector (within the region or adjacent regions).

name: llFloor

params.name: val
params.description: Number to round down.

description: Returns val rounded toward negative infinity. In other words, returns the largest integer less than or equal to val.

name: llForceMouselook

params.name: mouselook
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, forces a sitting avatar into mouselook; if FALSE, allows them to keep their current camera mode.

description: Sets whether any avatar sitting on this prim is forced into mouselook mode. Setting mouselook to TRUE forces the mode; FALSE (default) allows the avatar to keep their current camera mode.

name: llFrand

params.name: mag
params.description: Float magnitude of the random range.

description: Returns a pseudo-random float in the range [0.0, mag) or (mag, 0.0] depending on the sign of mag. The value is inclusive of 0.0 but exclusive of mag.

name: llGenerateKey
description: Generates and returns a unique versioned UUID key (utilizing SHA-1 hashing). Due to being versioned, it will not return NULL_KEY; however, the exact UUID version is an implementation detail that should not be relied upon.

name: llGetAccel
description: Returns a vector representing the acceleration of the object in the region's frame of reference.

name: llGetAgentInfo

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns an integer bitfield containing status information about the agent specified by id (such as AGENT_FLYING, AGENT_ATTACHMENTS, AGENT_SITTING, etc.).

name: llGetAgentLanguage

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns a string representing the language code of the preferred interface language set by the avatar.

name: llGetAgentList

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope flag (AGENT_LIST_PARCEL, AGENT_LIST_PARCEL_OWNER, or AGENT_LIST_REGION) to filter the returned agents.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to apply (currently unused).

description: Requests a list of avatar UUID keys for agents currently in the region, limited by scope. Returns a list of keys or a list containing an error message string.

name: llGetAgentSize

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns a vector representing the estimated bounding box size of the specified avatar, or ZERO_VECTOR if they are not in the same region.

name: llGetAlpha

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a float representing the Blinn-Phong alpha (transparency) of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, returns the mean average of all faces.

name: llGetAndResetTime
description: Returns the elapsed script time in seconds as a float, then resets the script timer to zero.

name: llGetAnimation

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns a string representing the name of the currently playing locomotion animation for the specified avatar.

name: llGetAnimationList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns a list of keys (UUIDs) representing all active animations currently playing on the specified avatar.

name: llGetAnimationOverride

params.name: anim_state
params.description: Animation state string to query.

description: Returns a string representing the name of the animation currently overriding the specified anim_state. Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS or PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION runtime permission.

name: llGetAttached
description: Returns the integer attachment point (an ATTACH_* constant) that the object is attached to, or 0 if it is unattached or pending detachment.

name: llGetAttachedList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Returns a list of object keys (UUIDs) worn by the specified avatar, in the order they were attached. HUDs are not included because they are neither public nor visible. Returns a list containing an error message string on failure.

name: llGetAttachedListFiltered

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to filter the returned attachments.

description: Returns a list of object keys (UUIDs) worn by the specified avatar, in the order they were attached, filtered by options. Returns a list containing an error message string on failure.

name: llGetBoundingBox

params.name: object
params.description: UUID of the avatar or prim in the same region.

description: Returns the bounding box of object (including any linked prims) relative to its root prim in local coordinates, formatted as [ (vector) min_corner, (vector) max_corner ].

name: llGetCameraAspect
description: Returns a float representing the camera's current aspect ratio (width/height) of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns 0.0 if permissions are not granted.

name: llGetCameraFOV
description: Returns a float representing the camera's current field of view (FOV) in radians of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns 0.0 if permissions are not granted.

name: llGetCameraPos
description: Returns a vector representing the camera's current position in region coordinates of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns ZERO_VECTOR if permissions are not granted.

name: llGetCameraRot
description: Returns a rotation representing the camera's current orientation of the agent who granted PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA. Returns ZERO_ROTATION if permissions are not granted.

name: llGetCenterOfMass
description: Returns the vector position (in region coordinates) of the center of mass. Returns the individual child prim's center of mass if called from a child, or the entire linkset's center of mass if called from the root.

name: llGetClosestNavPoint

params.name: point
params.description: Position vector in region-local coordinates.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of GCNP_* flags and parameters to configure the search limits.

description: Returns a list containing the closest vector position on the navigation mesh (navmesh) to the specified point (expressed in region-local space), or an empty list if none is found. Configured using options.

name: llGetColor

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns the Blinn-Phong RGB color vector of face (values between 0.0 and 1.0). If face is ALL_SIDES, returns the mean average of all faces.

name: llGetCreator
description: Returns the key (UUID) of the prim's original creator.

name: llGetDate
description: Returns a string representing the current date in the UTC time zone in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

name: llGetDayLength
description: Returns an integer representing the number of seconds in the environmental day cycle applied to the current parcel.

name: llGetDayOffset
description: Returns an integer representing the offset duration (in seconds) added to calculate the current environmental time on this parcel.

name: llGetDisplayName

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region or otherwise known to the region.

description: Returns the display name string of the avatar specified by id if they are in the region or cached; returns an empty string otherwise (use llRequestDisplayName if the avatar is absent).

name: llGetEnergy
description: Returns a float representing the remaining physics energy of the object as a percentage (0.0 to 1.0) of its maximum capacity.

name: llGetEnv

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the regional data to request (unrecognized strings return an empty string).

description: Returns a string containing the requested regional data specified by name.

name: llGetEnvironment

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates (X/Y determine the parcel, or region if X/Y are -1; Z determines the sky track altitude).

params.name: params
params.description: A list of environmental attributes to retrieve.

description: Returns a list containing the current environment parameters for the parcel or region at pos, retrieved in the order specified by params.

name: llGetExperienceDetails

params.name: experience_id
params.description: UUID of the experience to query (can be NULL_KEY to retrieve details for the script's own experience).

description: Returns a list of details for the specified experience_id, formatted as [string experience_name, key owner_id, key experience_id, integer state, string state_message, key group_id].

name: llGetExperienceErrorMessage

params.name: error
params.description: XP_ERROR_* error code constant to translate.

description: Returns a text description of the specified experience error code, or a description of XP_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ERROR if the error is invalid.

name: llGetForce
description: Returns a vector representing the constant force currently applied to the object (if the object is physical).

name: llGetFreeMemory
description: Returns an integer representing the number of free bytes of memory currently available to the script.

name: llGetFreeURLs
description: Returns an integer representing the number of available HTTP URLs (remaining for the owner if the object is attached, or for the region if unattached).

name: llGetGameControlMode

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

description: Returns a GAME_CONTROL_MODE_* integer indicating the current game-control mode for the avatar specified by id.

name: llGetGameControlModeAxes

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

description: Returns a list of floats representing the modal axes for the current game-control mode of the avatar specified by id. Element count and index meanings vary by mode; use the GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_* constants as indices.

name: llGetGameControlModeButtons

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar whose game-controller state to query.

description: Returns a bitmask of the modal buttons currently active for the current game-control mode of the avatar specified by id. Bit meanings vary by mode; use the GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_* constants as masks.

name: llGetGeometricCenter
description: Returns a vector representing the geometric center of the object relative to its root prim.

name: llGetGMTclock
description: Returns a float representing the time in seconds since midnight GMT (truncated to whole seconds).

name: llGetHealth

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the agent or object to query.

description: Returns a float representing the current health of the avatar or object specified by id.

name: llGetHTTPHeader

params.name: request_id
params.description: Unique key of the HTTP request.

params.name: header
params.description: Lowercase name of the HTTP header to retrieve.

description: Returns a string representing the value of the specified header associated with the HTTP request_id.

name: llGetInventoryAcquireTime

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns the time when the item was placed in the prim's inventory, as a UTC timestamp string of the form "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ"

name: llGetInventoryCreator

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the creator of the specified inventory item.

name: llGetInventoryDesc

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns the description string of the specified inventory item.

name: llGetInventoryKey

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the specified inventory item.

name: llGetInventoryName

params.name: type
params.description: INVENTORY_* type constant of the item.

params.name: index
params.description: Index of the item of that type.

description: Returns the name of the inventory item of the specified type (INVENTORY_*) at the specified inventory index.

name: llGetInventoryNumber

params.name: type
params.description: INVENTORY_* type constant to count.

description: Returns the count of items of the specified type (INVENTORY_*) in the prim's inventory.

name: llGetInventoryPermMask

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

params.name: group
params.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to get.

description: Returns the specified item's permission flags for the specified group.

name: llGetInventoryType

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns an integer representing the INVENTORY_* type of the named inventory item.

name: llGetKey
description: Returns the key (UUID) of the prim containing the script.

name: llGetLandOwnerAt

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the land owner at the vector pos, or NULL_KEY if the land is public.

name: llGetLinkKey

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the linked prim or avatar specified by link.

name: llGetLinkMedia

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of PRIM_MEDIA_* property constants to retrieve values for.

description: Returns a list containing the media parameters of the specified face on the linked prim link, retrieved in the order requested by params.

name: llGetLinkName

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

description: Returns a string containing the name of the linked prim specified by link.

name: llGetLinkNumber
description: Returns the integer link number of the prim containing the script (0 for unlinked, 1 for the root, and 2+ for children).

name: llGetLinkNumberOfSides

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

description: Returns an integer representing the number of sides (faces) of the linked prim specified by link.

name: llGetLinkPrimitiveParams

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag to retrieve parameters from.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of PRIM_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

description: Returns a list of primitive parameters requested in params for the linked prim specified by link (equivalent to llGetPrimitiveParams).

name: llGetLinkSitFlags

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

description: Returns an integer representing the active sit flags currently set on the linked prim specified by link.

name: llGetListEntryType

params.name: src
params.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

params.name: index
params.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

description: Returns an integer representing the variable type (TYPE_*) of the list entry at index in the list src.

name: llGetListLength

params.name: src
params.description: List to measure.

description: Returns an integer representing the total number of elements in the list src.

name: llGetLocalPos
description: Returns a position vector relative to the root prim. If called from the root prim, it returns the global region position (or the position relative to the attachment point if attached).

name: llGetLocalRot
description: Returns a rotation representing the local orientation of a child prim relative to the root prim, or the object's overall rotation if called from the root.

name: llGetMass
description: Returns a float representing the mass of the object (in lindograms). Returns the total linkset mass if called from the root, or the individual prim's mass if called from a child prim. Returns the wearer's mass if inside an attachment.

name: llGetMassMKS
description: Returns a float representing the mass of the object in kilograms. Functionally identical to llGetMass except for using MKS (metric) units.

name: llGetMaxScaleFactor
description: Returns a float representing the maximum scale factor that can be applied to the object via llScaleByFactor without violating size or linkability limits.

name: llGetMemoryLimit
description: Returns an integer representing the maximum memory limit (in bytes) that the script is allowed to allocate.

name: llGetMinScaleFactor
description: Returns a float representing the minimum scale factor that can be applied to the object via llScaleByFactor without violating size limits.

name: llGetMoonDirection
description: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the parcel's moon, taking altitude into account. Falls back to the region's moon direction if no custom parcel environment is set.

name: llGetMoonRotation
description: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the moon on the current parcel and altitude track. Falls back to the region's moon rotation if no custom parcel environment is set.

name: llGetNextEmail

params.name: address
params.description: Sender email address filter, or "" for any address.

params.name: subject
params.description: Email subject filter, or "" for any subject.

description:
Requests the next queued email via the email event. Emails must
1. Be sent to `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`
2. Be sent from the specified sender Address (or any address if blank)
3. Have the specified subject Subject (or any subject if blank)

name: llGetNotecardLine

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: line
params.description: Index of the line to read.

description: Asynchronously requests the text of line in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event, which receives EOF if line is past the end of the notecard.

name: llGetNotecardLineSync

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: line
params.description: Index of the line to read.

description: Synchronously reads the text of line in the notecard name from the region's cache, without raising a dataserver event. Returns NAK if the notecard is not cached, or EOF if line is past the end of the notecard.

name: llGetNumberOfNotecardLines

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the notecard in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

description: Asynchronously requests the number of lines in the notecard name. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

name: llGetNumberOfPrims
description: Returns an integer representing the total number of prims and seated avatars in the linkset containing the script.

name: llGetNumberOfSides
description: Returns an integer representing the total number of sides (faces) of the prim containing the script.

name: llGetObjectAnimationNames
description: Returns a list of strings representing the names or UUIDs of all active animations currently playing on the object.

name: llGetObjectDesc
description: Returns a string containing the description of the specific prim containing the script.

name: llGetObjectDetails

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar or prim (in the same or adjacent regions) to query.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of OBJECT_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

description: Returns a list containing the requested parameters of the specified avatar or object id, retrieved in the order requested by params.

name: llGetObjectLinkKey

params.name: object_id
params.description: UUID of the target prim or linkset.

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag of the prim to retrieve.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the linked child prim specified by link within the linkset identified by object_id.

name: llGetObjectMass

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar or object to query.

description: Returns a float representing the mass of the avatar or object specified by id.

name: llGetObjectName
description: Returns a string containing the name of the specific prim containing the script.

name: llGetObjectPermMask

params.name: group
params.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to get.

description: Returns the script's object's permission flags for the specified group.

name: llGetObjectPrimCount

params.name: prim
params.description: UUID of the prim in the same region.

description: Returns an integer representing the total number of prims in the object containing the specified prim.

name: llGetOmega
description: Returns a vector representing the physical rotation (angular velocity) of the object in radians per second.

name: llGetOwner
description: Returns the key (UUID) of the object's current owner.

name: llGetOwnerKey

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the prim in the same region.

description: Returns the key (UUID) of the owner of the prim specified by id.

name: llGetParcelDetails

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates (only the X and Y components are used).

params.name: params
params.description: A list of PARCEL_DETAILS_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

description: Returns a list containing the requested parcel details specified by params (retrieved in the same order) for the parcel at the vector pos.

name: llGetParcelFlags

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

description: Returns an integer bitfield of parcel flags (PARCEL_FLAG_*) for the parcel at the position pos.

name: llGetParcelMaxPrims

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

params.name: sim_wide
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, returns the combined land impact limit for all parcels owned by the parcel owner in the region; if FALSE, returns only the limit for the specified parcel.

description: Returns an integer representing the maximum combined land impact (prim limit) allowed for objects on the parcel at pos, determined either for the single parcel or sim-wide based on sim_wide.

name: llGetParcelMusicURL
description: Returns a string containing the parcel's streaming music (audio) URL. The object owner must also be the land owner (or share the same group deeding).

name: llGetParcelPrimCount

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates (the Z component is ignored).

params.name: category
params.description: PARCEL_COUNT_* category flag.

params.name: sim_wide
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, searches all parcels in the region owned by the targeted parcel's owner; if FALSE, searches only the specified parcel.

description: Returns an integer representing the total land impact of objects on the parcel at pos in the specified category. If sim_wide is TRUE, returns combined usage for all regional parcels owned by the parcel owner; if FALSE, returns usage for only the specified parcel.

name: llGetParcelPrimOwners

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates.

description: Returns a list of up to 100 strides (formatted as [key owner, integer land_impact]) representing owners of objects on the parcel at pos, sorted by owner key. Requires owner-like permissions for the parcel and the script owner's presence in the region.

name: llGetPermissions
description: Returns an integer bitfield representing the permissions (PERMISSION_*) currently granted to the script.

name: llGetPermissionsKey
description: Returns the key (UUID) of the avatar that last granted or declined permissions to the script, or NULL_KEY if the permissions request was ignored or cancelled.

name: llGetPhysicsMaterial
description: Returns a list of the format [float gravity_multiplier, float restitution, float friction, float density] detailing the physical characteristics of the object.

name: llGetPos
description: Returns a vector representing the current position of the object in region coordinates.

name: llGetPrimitiveParams

params.name: params
params.description: A list of PRIM_* flags specifying the attributes to retrieve.

description: Returns a list of primitive attribute values matching the requested params list.

name: llGetPrimMediaParams

params.name: face
params.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of PRIM_MEDIA_* property constants to retrieve values for.

description: Returns a list containing the media parameters of the specified face, retrieved in the order requested by params. Returns an empty list if no media exists on the face.

name: llGetRegionAgentCount
description: Returns an integer representing the current number of avatars in the region.

name: llGetRegionCorner
description: Returns a vector (in meters) representing the global grid coordinates of the south-west corner of the current region (Z component is always 0.0).

name: llGetRegionDayLength
description: Returns an integer representing the total number of seconds in the region-wide day cycle.

name: llGetRegionDayOffset
description: Returns an integer representing the offset duration (in seconds) added to calculate the current environmental time for the region.

name: llGetRegionFlags
description: Returns an integer bitfield representing the region flags (REGION_FLAG_*) currently enabled for the region containing the object.

name: llGetRegionFPS
description: Returns a float representing the average region simulator frames per second (FPS).

name: llGetRegionMoonDirection
description: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the region's moon, taking altitude into account.

name: llGetRegionMoonRotation
description: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the moon at the region level, taking altitude track into account.

name: llGetRegionName
description: Returns a string containing the name of the current region.

name: llGetRegionSunDirection
description: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the region's sun, taking altitude into account.

name: llGetRegionSunRotation
description: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the sun at the region level, taking altitude track into account.

name: llGetRegionTimeDilation
description: Returns a float representing the current physics time dilation of the region, ranging from 0.0 (full dilation / slow) to 1.0 (no dilation / real-world speed).

name: llGetRegionTimeOfDay
description: Returns a float with subsecond precision representing the elapsed seconds since region environmental midnight or region uptime (whichever is smaller). If the region's sun position is fixed, returns region uptime.

name: llGetRenderMaterial

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a string representing the render material on face (returns the inventory name if it is in the prim's inventory, or its key UUID otherwise).

name: llGetRootPosition
description: Returns a vector representing the position (in region coordinates) of the root prim of the linkset containing the script.

name: llGetRootRotation
description: Returns a rotation representing the orientation (relative to the region) of the root prim of the linkset containing the script.

name: llGetRot
description: Returns a rotation representing the prim's orientation relative to the region's axes.

name: llGetScale
description: Returns a vector representing the physical scale (dimensions in meters) of the prim containing the script.

name: llGetScriptName
description: Returns a string containing the name of the script calling this function.

name: llGetScriptState

params.name: script
params.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

description: Returns a boolean integer indicating whether the specified script in the prim's inventory is running (returns TRUE if running, FALSE otherwise).

name: llGetSimStats

params.name: stat_type
params.description: SIM_STAT_* flag of the statistic to retrieve.

description: Returns a float containing the value of the requested region statistic specified by stat_type.

name: llGetSimulatorHostname
description: Returns a string containing the hostname of the server machine running the script (e.g., 'sim225.agni.lindenlab.com').

name: llGetSPMaxMemory
description: Returns an integer representing the maximum memory (in bytes) used by the script while the memory profiler was last active (only valid after using PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY).

name: llGetStartParameter
description: Returns an integer representing the start/rez parameter passed to the object on creation (returns 0 if rezzed by an agent).

name: llGetStartString
description: Returns the initialization string passed to the object's root prim on rez with llRezObjectWithParams (via REZ_PARAM_STRING; returns an empty string if rezzed by an agent).

name: llGetStaticPath

params.name: start_pos
params.description: Starting position vector.

params.name: end_pos
params.description: Target end position vector.

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the character path, between 0.125m and 5.0m.

params.name: params
params.description: A list specifying the CHARACTER_TYPE parameter (defaults to CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE).

description: Returns a list of position vectors representing pathfinding waypoints between start and end on the static navmesh for a character of the specified radius. Ignores movable obstacles and can be used in any region regardless of dynamic pathfinding status.

name: llGetStatus

params.name: status
params.description: Single STATUS_* flag to check.

description: Returns a boolean integer indicating whether the specified status flag status is enabled for the object.

name: llGetSubString

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to slice.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Starting codepoint index (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

params.name: end_index
params.description: Ending codepoint index (inclusive). Supports negative indexing.

description: Returns a copy of the substring from src within the inclusive codepoint range start_index..end_index. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string. If start_index is greater than end_index, the substring is the excluded range.

name: llGetSunDirection
description: Returns a normalized vector representing the current direction of the parcel's sun, taking altitude into account. Falls back to the region's sun direction if no custom parcel environment is set.

name: llGetSunRotation
description: Returns a rotation representing the orientation applied to the sun on the current parcel and altitude track. Falls back to the region's sun rotation if no custom parcel environment is set.

name: llGetTexture

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a string representing the Blinn-Phong diffuse texture on face (returns the inventory name if it is a texture in the prim's inventory, or its key UUID otherwise).

name: llGetTextureOffset

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a vector containing the texture offsets of face in the X (horizontal U) and Y (vertical V) components (Z is unused).

name: llGetTextureRot

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a float representing the texture rotation angle (in radians) on face.

name: llGetTextureScale

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Returns a vector containing the texture scales of face in the X and Y components (Z is unused).

name: llGetTime
description: Returns a float representing the elapsed script time in seconds with subsecond precision (since the script started, was reset, or since the last call to llResetTime or llGetAndResetTime).

name: llGetTimeOfDay
description: Returns a float with subsecond precision representing the elapsed seconds since parcel environmental midnight or region uptime (whichever is smaller). If the parcel's sun position is fixed, returns region uptime.

name: llGetTimestamp
description: Returns a string containing the current date and time in the UTC time zone formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp ('YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.ff..fZ').

name: llGetTorque
description: Returns a vector representing the physical torque force currently acting on the object (if the object is physical).

name: llGetUnixTime
description: Returns an integer representing the current Unix timestamp (the number of seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 Jan 1, 1970 UTC).

name: llGetUsedMemory
description: Returns an integer representing the total number of bytes of memory currently used by the script (non-Mono scripts always return 16,384 bytes).

name: llGetUsername

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region or otherwise known to the region.

description: Returns a string representing the unique username of the avatar specified by id if they are connected to the region or cached; returns an empty string otherwise (use llRequestUsername if the avatar is absent).

name: llGetVel
description: Returns a vector representing the velocity of the object (in meters per second) relative to the global region coordinates. For physical objects, returns the velocity of its center of mass.

name: llGetVisualParams

params.name: agentid
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of visual parameter IDs or names to retrieve values for.

description: Returns a list containing the values of the visual parameters requested in params for the agent specified by agentid.

name: llGetWallclock
description: Returns a float representing the time in seconds since midnight Pacific Time (PST/PDT), which is equivalent to Second Life Time (SLT) truncated to whole seconds.

name: llGiveAgentInventory

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the target agent in the same region.

params.name: folder
params.description: Name of the destination folder to be created

params.name: items
params.description: The names of the items in the prim's inventory to transfer.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to configure the inventory transfer.

description: Gives the specified inventory items to the agent as a new folder named folder, as permitted by the permissions system. Customizes the transfer using options.

name: llGiveInventory

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target agent or prim.

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory to transfer.

description: Gives the specified inventory item to the target, as permitted by the permissions system. The target can be any agent or an object located in the same region.

name: llGiveInventoryList

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target agent or prim in the same region.

params.name: folder
params.description: Name of the destination folder to be created (ignored if the target is an object).

params.name: items
params.description: The names of the items in the prim's inventory to transfer.

description: Gives the list of inventory items to target as a new folder named folder. If target is an object, the items are passed directly into its inventory and no folder is created. The target must be an agent or an object in the same region.

name: llGiveMoney

params.name: destination
params.description: UUID of the destination avatar.

params.name: amount
params.description: Number of L$ to transfer (must be greater than 0).

description: Transfers the specified amount of L$ from the script owner to the destination avatar. Silently fails if the PERMISSION_DEBIT permission has not been granted. Returns 0 (use llTransferLindenDollars to match transactions to transaction_result events).

name: llGodLikeRezObject

params.name: id
params.description: Asset UUID of the object to rez.

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the object will be rezzed.

description: Rezzes an object directly from a UUID specified by id at the position pos, provided the owner has the god-bit set.

name: llGround

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a float representing the ground height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llGroundContour

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a vector representing the ground contour direction (the direction with no change in elevation) directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llGroundNormal

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a vector representing the ground surface normal vector directly below the current position offset by the vector offset.

name: llGroundRepel

params.name: height
params.description: Target distance in meters above the ground or water.

params.name: water
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, damp relative to the higher of land and water; if FALSE, damp relative to land only.

params.name: tau
params.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the movement.

description: Critically damps the object's vertical motion to height (using critical damping timescale tau) if it is within height * 0.5 of the terrain (or water level if water is TRUE). Only works on physics-enabled objects; do not use with vehicles.

name: llGroundSlope

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a vector representing the ground slope directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llHash

params.name: val
params.description: String to hash.

description: Returns an integer representing the 32-bit hash value of the string val (returns 0 if the string is empty).

name: llHMAC

params.name: private_key
params.description: PEM-formatted secret key to use for the HMAC hash.

params.name: msg
params.description: Message string to be hashed.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

description: Returns a Base64-encoded HMAC hash of msg using the secret key private_key and the specified digest algorithm (md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512).

name: llHTTPRequest

params.name: url
params.description: Destination HTTP or HTTPS URL.

params.name: parameters

description: Returns TRUE if the avatar or object specified by key id is over land owned by the script owner, or FALSE otherwise.

name: llOwnerSay

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to send to the object owner.

description: Sends the chat message msg privately to the object owner (the owner must be currently in the same region for the message to be received).

name: llParcelMediaCommandList

params.name: commandList
params.description: A list containing integer PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* flags and their corresponding parameters.

description: Controls the playback of movies and other multimedia resources on a parcel or for an agent, using the PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* settings specified in commandList.

name: llParcelMediaQuery

params.name: query
params.description: A list of PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* attributes to query.

description: Queries the media properties of the parcel containing the script, returning a list of values in the order requested by query. Only works if the object is owned by the landowner or deeded to the land's group.

name: llParseString2List

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to parse.

params.name: separators
params.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing separators to be discarded.

params.name: spacers
params.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing spacers to be preserved in the list.

description: Breaks the string src into a list of substrings, discarding any separators, keeping spacers, and omitting any empty null values. separators and spacers accept up to 8 string entries each.

name: llParseStringKeepNulls

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to parse.

params.name: separators
params.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing separators to be discarded.

params.name: spacers
params.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing spacers to be preserved in the list.

description: Breaks the string src into a list of substrings, discarding separators and keeping spacers, while preserving empty null values (unlike llParseString2List). separators and spacers accept up to 8 string entries each.

name: llParticleSystem

params.name: rules
params.description: A list of particle system rules and data pairs [rule1, data1, ...].

description: Creates or updates a particle system on the prim containing the script based on rules. An empty list removes the particle system.

name: llPassCollisions

params.name: pass
params.description: A PASS_* flag (e.g., PASS_ALWAYS, PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED, or PASS_NEVER).

description: Sets the pass-collisions attribute. If pass is TRUE, collision events are passed from child prims to the root; if FALSE (default), they only trigger events in the affected child prim.

name: llPassTouches

params.name: pass
params.description: A PASS_* flag (e.g., PASS_ALWAYS, PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED, or PASS_NEVER).

description: Sets the pass-touches attribute. If pass is TRUE, touch events are passed from child prims to the root; if FALSE (default), they only trigger events in the affected child prim.

name: llPatrolPoints

params.name: patrolPoints
params.description: A list of at least two position vectors representing the patrol path.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of PATROL_* flags and parameters to configure the patrol behavior.

description: Directs a pathfinding character to patrol sequentially through the coordinates specified in patrolPoints, configured by options.

name: llPlaySound

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

description: Plays the specified sound once at volume, attached to the object. Only one sound can be attached to a prim at a time; new sounds or calling llStopSound stops previous playback. A second call with the same sound adjusts the volume without restarting it.

name: llPlaySoundSlave

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

description: Plays the attached sound once at volume, synchronized to the next loop point of the most audible active Sync Master.

name: llPointAt

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector to point at.

description: Directs the avatar owning the object to point at the vector pos.

name: llPow

params.name: base
params.description: Base number.

params.name: exponent
params.description: Exponent number.

description: Returns base raised to the power exponent. If result is imaginary, returns NaN.

name: llPreloadSound

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of the sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

description: Causes nearby viewers in range to preload the specified sound from the object's inventory to prevent playback delays.

name: llPursue

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to pursue.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options to configure pursuit behavior.

description: Directs a pathfinding character to pursue and chase target, configured by the parameters specified in options.

name: llPushObject

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target avatar or object in the same region.

params.name: impulse
params.description: Linear impulse vector representing the direction and force of the push.

params.name: ang_impulse
params.description: Angular impulse vector representing the rotational force.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, forces are applied relative to the target's local axes; if FALSE, relative to region axes.

description: Applies physical impulse (force) and ang_impulse (rotational force) to the specified target avatar or object.

name: llReadKeyValue

params.name: k
params.description: Key of the key-value pair to read.

description: Starts an asynchronous transaction to read the value associated with key k in the experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist.

name: llRefreshPrimURL
description: Legacy function intended to reload the web page displayed on the prim's faces (currently non-functional).

name: llRegionSay

params.name: channel
params.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value except zero) to chat the message on.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to broadcast.

description: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts listening on channel Channel within the region. PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) cannot be used, so, only scripts can receive the message.

name: llRegionSayTo

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target agent or prim in the same region.

params.name: channel
params.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to chat the message on.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to send.

description: Sends the message msg on Channel privately to the targeted agent or object (if within the region). If target is an agent and channel is non-zero, the message can also be heard by any attachments worn by the avatar.

name: llReleaseCamera

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Deprecated. Intended to return camera control back to the avatar (use llClearCameraParams instead).

name: llReleaseControls
description: Stops taking inputs (previously acquired via llTakeControls) from the avatar, dequeuing any remaining control events and revoking the PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS permission.

name: llReleaseURL

params.name: url
params.description: URL string to release.

description: Releases the specified url (previously obtained via llRequestURL), rendering it no longer usable.

name: llRemoteDataReply

params.name: channel
params.description: XML-RPC channel ID.

params.name: message_id
params.description: XML-RPC message ID.

params.name: sdata
params.description: String payload data to reply with.

params.name: idata
params.description: Integer payload data to reply with.

description: Deprecated. Sends an XML-RPC reply on channel to message_id with payload string sdata and integer idata.

name: llRemoteDataSetRegion
description: Deprecated. Used with XML-RPC to reregister remote data channels if the object moves to another region.

name: llRemoteLoadScript

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target prim.

params.name: script
params.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

params.name: running
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sets the copied script to run immediately; if FALSE, leaves it stopped.

params.name: start_param
params.description: Integer start parameter passed to the copied script (readable via llGetStartParameter).

description: Deprecated.

name: llRemoteLoadScriptPin

params.name: target
params.description: UUID of the target prim in the same region.

params.name: script
params.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

params.name: pin
params.description: Integer PIN code (must match the PIN set on the ObjectID via llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin).

params.name: running
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sets the copied script to run immediately; if FALSE, leaves it stopped.

params.name: start_param
params.description: Integer start parameter passed to the copied script (readable via llGetStartParameter).

description: Copies the script into target, setting it running (if running is TRUE) with the start_param, provided the script owner has modify permissions on target and target's PIN matches pin (set via llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin).

name: llRemoveFromLandBanList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar to remove.

description: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's ban list.

name: llRemoveFromLandPassList

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar to remove.

description: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's pass/access list.

name: llRemoveInventory

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory to remove.

description: Permanently deletes the named inventory item from the prim's inventory.

name: llRemoveVehicleFlags

params.name: flags
params.description: A bitwise mask of VEHICLE_FLAG_* constants to disable.

description: Disables the specified vehicle flags (sets them to FALSE) using the bitwise mask flags.

name: llReplaceAgentEnvironment

params.name: agent_id
params.description: UUID of an agent in the region participating in the experience.

params.name: transition
params.description: Duration in seconds over which to transition to the new environment.

params.name: environment
params.description: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

description: Replaces the region and parcel environment seen by the specified agent_id as part of an experience, transitioning the settings over transition seconds. Passing NULL_KEY or an empty string for environment restores defaults.

name: llReplaceEnvironment

params.name: position
params.description: Position vector of the target parcel (the Z component is ignored; use <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0> for the entire region).

params.name: environment
params.description: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

params.name: track_no
params.description: The elevation track to change (0: water, 1: ground, 2: 1000m, 3: 2000m, 4: 3000m, -1: all tracks).

params.name: day_length
params.description: Day cycle length in seconds (-1 to leave unchanged).

params.name: day_offset
params.description: Day cycle offset in seconds from UTC (-1 to leave unchanged).

description: Replaces the environment on the parcel containing position (or the entire region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0>) for the specified track_no. Modifies day_length and day_offset if specified. Requires edit permissions on the parcel or estate management rights.

name: llReplaceSubString

params.name: src
params.description: Original source string to search.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Substring pattern to find and replace.

params.name: replacement_pattern
params.description: New substring that replaces the pattern.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of replacements to make (0 for all, positive for left-to-right, negative for right-to-left).

description: Returns a copy of src with count occurrences of pattern replaced by replacement_pattern. Setting count to 0 replaces all occurrences; positive counts process left-to-right, while negative counts process right-to-left.

name: llRequestAgentData

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the agent.

params.name: data
params.description: DATA_* category flag of the requested information.

description: Asynchronously requests the specified data category (DATA_*) about the agent id. Triggers a dataserver event with the results and returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestDisplayName

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar to query.

description: Asynchronously requests the display name of the agent specified by id, triggering a dataserver event with the results. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestExperiencePermissions

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the agent to request permissions from.

params.name: name
params.description: Deprecated parameter (no longer used).

description: Requests permission from the specified agent to participate in the experience. These permissions are persistent and apply grid-wide across all scripts in the experience, automatically triggering experience_permissions or experience_permissions_denied.

name: llRequestInventoryData

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

description: Asynchronously requests data for the named inventory item, triggering a dataserver event. Currently, only landmark items are supported (which return local region coordinates). Returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestPermissions

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

params.name: permissions
params.description: Bitfield containing the PERMISSION_* constants to request.

description: Requests permissions (a bitfield specified by permissions) from the agent in the same region, calling run_time_permissions if granted. This call does not pause script execution.

name: llRequestSecureURL
