description: Asynchronously requests one secure HTTPS (SSL, port 12043) URL for use by this object, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestSimulatorData

params.name: region
params.description: Case-sensitive region name.

params.name: data
params.description: DATA_SIM_* flag of the requested simulator data.

description: Asynchronously requests data (using a DATA_SIM_* constant) about the region. Triggers a dataserver event and returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestURL
description: Asynchronously requests one HTTP URL for use by this script, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

name: llRequestUserKey

params.name: username
params.description: Current or historical username of the avatar to resolve.

description: Asynchronously requests the Agent ID key (UUID) for the agent specified by their current or historical username, returning NULL_KEY if not found. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

name: llRequestUsername

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar to query.

description: Asynchronously requests the unique single-word username of the agent identified by id, triggering a dataserver event. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

name: llResetAnimationOverride

params.name: anim_state
params.description: Animation state string (or 'ALL') to reset.

description: Resets the animation override for anim_state to its default value (use 'ALL' to reset all states). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

name: llResetLandBanList
description: Removes all blocked residents from the land parcel's ban list.

name: llResetLandPassList
description: Removes all residents from the land parcel's access/pass list.

name: llResetOtherScript

params.name: script
params.description: Name of the target script in the prim's inventory.

description: Resets the named script name in the prim's inventory.

name: llResetScript
description: Resets the current script.

name: llResetTime
description: Resets the script's elapsed time timer back to zero.

name: llReturnObjectsByID

params.name: objects
params.description: A list of object UUID keys to return.

description: Returns objects specified by the list of UUIDs objects to their owners. Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

name: llReturnObjectsByOwner

params.name: owner
params.description: UUID of the avatar or group whose objects will be returned.

params.name: scope
params.description: OBJECT_RETURN_* scope flag (such as OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL, OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL_OWNER, or OBJECT_RETURN_REGION).

description: Returns objects owned by owner within the specified scope (parcel, parcel owner, or region). Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

name: llRezAtRoot

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the root of the object will be placed.

params.name: vel
params.description: Initial velocity vector for the rezzed object.

params.name: rot
params.description: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

params.name: start_param
params.description: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

description: Instantiates the named inventory object with the root prim at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing start_param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

name: llRezObject

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the center of the object will be placed.

params.name: vel
params.description: Initial velocity vector (maximum magnitude ~200m/s).

params.name: rot
params.description: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

params.name: start_param
params.description: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

description: Instantiates the named inventory object with the bounding box centered at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

name: llRezObjectWithParams

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of REZ_* options to configure the rezzed object's attributes.

description: Instantiates the named inventory object (defaulting to the rezzing prim's position unless REZ_POS is specified) using the initial set of parameters specified in options. Returns the key of the rezzed object, or a blank key on failure.

name: llRot2Angle

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to evaluate.

description: Returns the angle, in radians, that q rotates.

name: llRot2Axis

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to evaluate.

description: Returns the unit vector axis that q rotates around.

name: llRot2Euler

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to convert.

description: Returns a vector of Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) of q. The angles will be in radians.

name: llRot2Fwd

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to convert.

description: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive X (forward) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <1, 0, 0> * q.

name: llRot2Left

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to convert.

description: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Y (left) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 1, 0> * q.

name: llRot2Up

params.name: q
params.description: Rotation to convert.

description: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Z (up) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 0, 1> * q.

name: llRotateTexture

params.name: angle
params.description: Rotation angle expressed in radians.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the texture rotation of face to the specified angle (in radians). If face is ALL_SIDES, rotates the texture on all faces.

name: llRotBetween

params.name: start_vec
params.description: Starting vector.

params.name: end_vec
params.description: Ending vector.

description: Returns the shortest-path quaternion that rotates start_vec onto end_vec.

name: llRotLookAt

params.name: target_direction
params.description: Target rotation to align the object with.

params.name: strength
params.description: Force of rotation (0.0 cancels the tracking; values around half the object's mass are typical).

params.name: damping
params.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the rotation.

description: Causes the object to smoothly rotate to target_direction with a force defined by strength and damping. A strength of 0.0 cancels the rotation target. Rotation is maintained until stopped with llStopLookAt.

name: llRotTarget

params.name: rot
params.description: Target rotation to track.

params.name: error
params.description: Tolerance angle in radians defining when the target rotation is considered reached.

description: Registers the rotation rot with a leeway tolerance error (in radians) as a target, triggering at_rot_target and not_at_rot_target events. Returns an integer handle to unregister the target via llRotTargetRemove.

name: llRotTargetRemove

params.name: handle
params.description: Integer target handle returned by llRotTarget to remove.

description: Removes the rotational target specified by the integer handle registered with llRotTarget.

name: llRound

params.name: val
params.description: Number to round.

description: Returns val rounded to the nearest integer. Halfway values are rounded toward infinity.

name: llSameGroup

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or prim to check.

description: Returns TRUE if the agent or object specified by uuid is in the same region (simulator) and shares the same active group as the prim containing the script; returns FALSE otherwise.

name: llSay

params.name: channel
params.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to chat the message on.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to broadcast.

description: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("chat_range"), which is 20m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

name: llScaleByFactor

params.name: scaling_factor
params.description: Multiplier scale factor to apply to the prim sizes and their local positions.

description: Attempts to uniformly resize the entire object by scaling_factor, maintaining size-position ratios of the prims. Fails if the linkset is physical, a pathfinding character, in keyframed motion, would exceed prim scale/linkability limits, or would overflow parcel capacity.

name: llScaleTexture

params.name: u
params.description: Horizontal (U) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

params.name: v
params.description: Vertical (V) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the diffuse texture horizontal u and vertical v scales (repeats) on the specified face of the prim. Setting face to ALL_SIDES updates all sides. Negative scale values flip the texture.

name: llScriptDanger

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates to check.

description: Returns TRUE if the vector position pos is over public land, sandbox land, land restricting edit/build permissions, or land that disables outside scripts.

name: llScriptProfiler

params.name: flags
params.description: PROFILE_* flag (such as PROFILE_NONE or PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY) to set the profiling state.

description: Enables or disables the script's profiling state using flags (supports PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY on Mono, or PROFILE_NONE). Active profiling can significantly reduce script performance.

name: llSendRemoteData

params.name: channel
params.description: XML-RPC channel ID.

params.name: dest
params.description: Destination XML-RPC URL or server.

params.name: idata
params.description: Integer payload data.

params.name: sdata
params.description: String payload data.

description: Deprecated. Sends an XML-RPC request to dest on channel, containing the channel ID as a string, integer idata, and string sdata. Returns a key representing the message_id.

name: llSensor

params.name: name
params.description: Specific object or avatar name to filter for (or empty string for no filter).

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

params.name: type
params.description: Integer bitfield type mask containing AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED (0 for no filter).

params.name: radius
params.description: Maximum distance in meters to scan (range [0.0, 96.0]).

params.name: arc
params.description: Maximum angle in radians relative to the local X-axis to scan (range [0.0, PI]).

description: Performs a single scan from the prim's forward vector for name and id of type within radius meters and arc radians. Results trigger a sensor or no_sensor event. Passing empty filters (blank name, 0 type, or NULL_KEY id) disables that filter.

name: llSensorRemove
description: Removes the periodic sensor previously configured by llSensorRepeat.

name: llSensorRepeat

params.name: name
params.description: Specific object or avatar name to filter for (or empty string for no filter).

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

params.name: type
params.description: Integer bitfield type mask containing AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED (0 for no filter).

params.name: radius
params.description: Maximum distance in meters to scan (range [0.0, 96.0]).

params.name: arc
params.description: Maximum angle in radians relative to the local X-axis to scan (range [0.0, PI]).

params.name: rate
params.description: Interval in seconds between repeated scans.

description: Sets up a repeating periodic scan every rate seconds for name and id of type within radius meters and arc radians of the forward vector. Results trigger sensor or no_sensor events.

name: llSetAgentEnvironment

params.name: agent_id
params.description: UUID of the agent participating in the experience.

params.name: transition
params.description: Transition duration in seconds.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of environmental parameters to apply.

description: Sets an individual agent's environmental settings using the attributes in params over a duration of transition seconds. Must be used as part of an experience; passing an empty list removes overrides.

name: llSetAgentRot

params.name: rot
params.description: Target rotation to turn the avatar to face.

params.name: flags
params.description: Flags to configure the rotation behavior.

description: Sets the rotation of the avatar to rot, controlled by flags.

name: llSetAlpha

params.name: alpha
params.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid; clamped to a minimum of 0.1).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the diffuse texture alpha (opacity) of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies to all faces. Values are clamped between 0.1 and 1.0 (where 1.0 is fully opaque).

name: llSetAngularVelocity

params.name: initial_omega
params.description: Angular velocity vector to apply (in radians per second).

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, initial_omega is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

description: Sets the angular velocity of a physical object to initial_omega (mass-independent). If local is TRUE, applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, applied in global coordinates. Has no effect on non-physical objects.

name: llSetAnimationOverride

params.name: anim_state
params.description: Animation state to override.

params.name: anim
params.description: Name of an animation in the prim's inventory, or a built-in animation name.

description: Overrides the default animation for anim_state with anim (which must be in the object's inventory or a built-in animation). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

name: llSetBuoyancy

params.name: buoyancy
params.description: Float buoyancy value to set.

description: Sets the buoyancy of a physical object (requires physics to be enabled). A value of 0.0 offers no buoyancy, < 1.0 sinks, 1.0 counteracts gravity, and > 1.0 rises.

name: llSetCameraAtOffset

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

description: Sets the target offset vector (in local coordinates) that a seated avatar's camera will look at.

name: llSetCameraEyeOffset

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

description: Sets the eye offset vector (in local coordinates) where a seated avatar's camera is positioned.

name: llSetCameraParams

params.name: rules
params.description: A strided list of rules and data pairs configuring the camera.

description: Sets multiple camera parameters simultaneously using the list of rules. Requires the PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA runtime permission.

name: llSetClickAction

params.name: action
params.description: CLICK_ACTION_* flag representing the action to apply.

description: Sets the action (a CLICK_ACTION_* flag) performed when an avatar left-clicks the prim.

name: llSetColor

params.name: color
params.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the Blinn-Phong diffuse RGB color of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies the color to all faces.

name: llSetContentType

params.name: request_id
params.description: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request.

params.name: content_type
params.description: CONTENT_TYPE_* constant representing the Internet media type to use.

description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent HTTP server responses (via llHTTPResponse) for request_id using the specified content_type (a CONTENT_TYPE_* constant).

name: llSetDamage

params.name: damage
params.description: Float damage value to set (range -100.0 for full heal to 100.0 for instant kill).

description: Sets the amount of damage delivered when this object hits an avatar. The object is immediately destroyed upon inflicting damage, and no collision event is triggered.

name: llSetEnvironment

params.name: position
params.description: Position vector in region coordinates to specify the target parcel, or <-1.0, -1.0, z> for the entire region (where z specifies the sky track, or -1 for all tracks).

params.name: params
params.description: A list of environmental attributes and values to apply (or empty to clear).

description: Overrides the environmental settings at position for a parcel (or region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, z>) using the parameters in params. Passing an empty params list removes previous overrides.

name: llSetForce

params.name: force
params.description: Directional force vector to apply.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, force is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

description: Applies a constant linear force to a physical object. If local is TRUE, force is applied relative to local coordinates; if FALSE, applied relative to region coordinates.

name: llSetForceAndTorque

params.name: force
params.description: Directional linear force vector.

params.name: torque
params.description: Torque rotational force vector.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, force and torque are treated as local vectors; if FALSE, as global region vectors.

description: Sets both the constant linear force and constant torque acting on a physical object. If local is TRUE, forces are applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, in global coordinates.

name: llSetGroundTexture

params.name: changes
params.description: A list of terrain detail properties and values to change.

description: Changes the painted terrain textures on the region based on changes. The script owner must have estate management rights. Returns an integer status.

name: llSetHoverHeight

params.name: height
params.description: Distance to hover above the ground or water.

params.name: water
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, hovers above water too; if FALSE, water is ignored.

params.name: tau
params.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the movement.

description: Critically damps the physical object's vertical movement to hover at height (above ground, or above water if water is TRUE) in tau seconds. Do not use with vehicles; call llStopHover to cancel.

name: llSetInventoryPermMask

params.name: item
params.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

params.name: group
params.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to set.

params.name: flags
params.description: Bitfield of permissions (PERM_* flags) to set.

description: Sets the specified item's permission flags for the specified group.

name: llSetKeyframedMotion

params.name: keyframes
params.description: A strided list of the form [vector position, rotation orientation, float time] representing sequential relative keyframes (minimum time is 1/9s).

params.name: options
params.description: A list of options (KFM_* constants) to modify playback behavior.

description: Smoothly moves a non-physical object between the positions, orientations, and times specified in the keyframes list, configured via options. Collisions with keyframed objects are ignored. An empty keyframes list terminates the motion.

name: llSetLinkAlpha

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: alpha
params.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the Blinn-Phong alpha (transparency) of face on the linked prim link.

name: llSetLinkCamera

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: eye
params.description: Eye offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

params.name: at
params.description: Look-at offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

description: Sets the camera eye position offset eye and looking-at position offset at for avatars who sit on the linked prim link.

name: llSetLinkColor

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: color
params.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Sets the Blinn-Phong diffuse RGB color of face on the linked prim link.

name: llSetLinkGLTFOverrides

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

params.name: params
params.description: A list of overrides and their corresponding values to set.

description: Sets or removes individual GLTF override parameters specified by params on face of the linked prim link.

name: llSetLinkMedia

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

params.name: params
params.description: A set of property-value pairs (in no particular order) specifying media parameters, or a PrimMediaParams dictionary.

description: Sets the media parameters specified by params on face of the linked prim link without a script delay. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing success or failure.

name: llSetLinkPrimitiveParams

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: rules
params.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

description: Deprecated (use llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast instead). Sets primitive parameters for the linked prim link according to rules.

name: llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: rules
params.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

description: Sets primitive parameters for the linked prim link according to rules with no built-in script sleep delay.

name: llSetLinkRenderMaterial

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: material
params.description: Name of a material in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Applies material (UUID or inventory name) to face of the linked prim link. Note: This clears most PRIM_GLTF_* properties on the face except for repeats, offsets, and rotation.

name: llSetLinkSitFlags

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: flags
params.description: A bitfield of sit flags (SIT_FLAG_*) to apply.

description: Sets the sit target flags for the linked prim link inside the linkset.

name: llSetLinkTexture

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

params.name: texture
params.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Applies texture (UUID or inventory name) to face of the linked prim link.

name: llSetLinkTextureAnim

params.name: link
params.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag to animate.

params.name: mode
params.description: Bitfield of texture animation mode flags (ANIM_ON, LOOP, etc.).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

params.name: sizex
params.description: Number of horizontal frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

params.name: sizey
params.description: Number of vertical frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

params.name: start
params.description: Start frame number (or radians for ROTATE).

params.name: length
params.description: Number of frames to display (or radians for ROTATE).

params.name: rate
params.description: Playback rate in frames per second (or radians/sec for ROTATE, UV coords/sec for SMOOTH). Must not be zero.

description: Animates the texture on face of the linked prim link by setting the scale and offset according to mode. Parameters sizex/sizey define frames, start defines the start frame/angle, length defines duration, and rate defines playback speed.

name: llSetLocalRot

params.name: rot
params.description: Local rotation to set.

description: Sets the rotation of a child prim relative to its root prim using rot.

name: llSetMemoryLimit

params.name: limit
params.description: Integer memory limit in bytes to reserve (must be less than the 64KB maximum).

description: Requests that limit bytes are reserved for the script. Returns TRUE on success or FALSE on failure (has no effect in LSO).

name: llSetObjectDesc

params.name: description
params.description: New description string (up to 127 characters).

description: Sets the description of the prim containing the script to description (limited to 127 characters).

name: llSetObjectName

params.name: name
params.description: New name string.

description: Sets the name of the prim containing the script to name.

name: llSetObjectPermMask

params.name: group
params.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to set.

params.name: flags
params.description: Bitfield of permissions (PERM_* flags) to set.

description: Sets the scripts's object's permission flags for the specified group.

name: llSetParcelForSale

params.name: ForSale
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, puts the parcel up for sale; if FALSE, removes it from sale.

params.name: Options
params.description: A list of options to configure the sale (e.g., price, authorized buyer, and object inclusion).

description: Sets the parcel the object is on for sale. If ForSale is TRUE, puts the land up for sale using Options (price, buyer, objects included). Setting ForSale to FALSE removes the parcel from sale. Requires parcel ownership and the PERMISSION_PRIVILEGED_LAND_ACCESS permission. Returns an error code or 0 if successful.

name: llSetParcelMusicURL

params.name: url
params.description: Streaming audio URL string.

description: Sets the streaming audio (music) URL for the parcel containing the object. The object owner must match the landowner or land group.

name: llSetPayPrice

params.name: price
params.description: Default price integer shown in the text field (can accept PAY_* constants or positive values).

params.name: quick_pay_buttons
params.description: A list of four integer values or PAY_* constants specifying the button payment choices.

description: Suggests default amounts for the pay text input field price and the four payment dialog quick_pay_buttons when an avatar pays this object.

name: llSetPhysicsMaterial

params.name: mask
params.description: Bitwise mask combination specifying which of the floats (DENSITY, FRICTION, RESTITUTION, or GRAVITY_MULTIPLIER) to apply.

params.name: gravity_multiplier
params.description: Gravity multiplier float value (range [-1.0, +28.0], default is 1.0).

params.name: restitution
params.description: Elasticity restitution float value (range [0.0, 1.0]).

params.name: friction
params.description: Friction coefficient float value (range [0.0, 255.0]).

params.name: density
params.description: Density float value in kg/m³ (range [1.0, 22587.0]).

description: Configures the physical characteristics of an object. The mask bitfield specifies which of the other parameters (gravity_multiplier, restitution, friction, or density) should be applied to the object.

name: llSetPos

params.name: pos
params.description: Position vector to move to (in region coordinates, or local coordinates if in a child prim).

description: Moves the non-physical object or prim toward the vector pos (up to 10m). If called in a child prim, pos is treated as root-relative; if called from the root prim, the entire object is moved.

name: llSetPrimitiveParams

params.name: rules
params.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

description: Deprecated (use llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast instead). Sets the prim's attributes according to rules.

name: llSetPrimMediaParams

params.name: face
params.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

params.name: params
params.description: A set of property-value pairs (in no particular order) specifying media parameters.

description: Sets the media parameters specified by params on the designated face of the prim. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing success or failure.

name: llSetPrimURL

params.name: url
params.description: Web URL to display.

description: Deprecated (use llSetPrimMediaParams instead). Updates the URL displayed on the prim's faces.

name: llSetRegionPos

params.name: position
params.description: Target position vector in region coordinates (can cross up to 10m over a region border).

description: Tries to move the entire object so that its root prim is within 0.1m of the vector position (underground positions are set to ground level). Returns TRUE on success or FALSE on failure.

name: llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin

params.name: pin
params.description: Integer PIN code (non-zero enables, zero disables).

description: Sets the prim's remote script access PIN to pin (a non-zero value enables loading via llRemoteLoadScriptPin, while zero disables it).

name: llSetRenderMaterial

params.name: material
params.description: Name of a material in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Applies material (UUID or inventory name) to face of the prim. Note: This clears most PRIM_GLTF_* properties on the face except for repeats, offsets, and rotation.

name: llSetRot

params.name: rot
params.description: Target rotation.

description: Sets the rotation of the prim to rot. If in a child prim, rot is treated as root-relative; if in the root prim of a non-physical object, rotates the entire object.

name: llSetScale

params.name: size
params.description: Target size vector.

description: Sets the physical scale (dimensions) of the prim containing the script to size.

name: llSetScriptState

params.name: script
params.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

params.name: running
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables the script; if FALSE, disables it.

description: Sets the running state of the named script in the prim's inventory. If running is TRUE, the script is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

name: llSetSitText

params.name: text
params.description: Context menu text to display.

description: Displays the string text instead of 'Sit' (or 'Sit Here') in the viewer's right-click context menu.

name: llSetSoundQueueing

params.name: queue
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sound queuing is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

description: Sets whether attached sounds wait for the current sound to end before playing (enables queuing if queue is TRUE, disables if FALSE). The queue is one level deep.

name: llSetSoundRadius

params.name: radius
params.description: Maximum distance in meters at which the sounds can be heard.

description: Limits the audibility radius of attached and triggered scripted sounds to distance radius.

name: llSetStatus

params.name: status
params.description: Bitmask representing the STATUS_* flag(s) to change.

params.name: value
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables the status; if FALSE, disables it.

description: Sets the object status attributes specified by status to value.

name: llSetText

params.name: text
params.description: Floating text string to display.

params.name: color
params.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

params.name: alpha
params.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid).

description: Displays floating text above the prim with the specified color vector and transparency alpha.

name: llSetTexture

params.name: texture
params.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

description: Applies the Blinn-Phong diffuse texture to face of the prim.

name: llSetTextureAnim

params.name: mode
params.description: Bitfield of texture animation mode flags (ANIM_ON, LOOP, etc.).

params.name: face
params.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

params.name: sizex
params.description: Number of horizontal frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

params.name: sizey
params.description: Number of vertical frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

params.name: start
params.description: Start frame number (or radians for ROTATE).

params.name: length
params.description: Number of frames to display (or radians for ROTATE).

params.name: rate
params.description: Playback rate in frames per second (or radians/sec for ROTATE, UV coords/sec for SMOOTH). Must not be zero.

description: Animates the texture on face of the prim by setting its scale and offset. mode defines options, sizex/sizey define frames, start defines the start frame/angle, length defines duration, and rate defines playback speed.

name: llSetTimerEvent

params.name: sec
params.description: Interval in seconds between timer events (0.0 to disable).

description: Sets a timer to trigger a timer event periodically every sec seconds. Passing 0.0 stops further timer events.

name: llSetTorque

params.name: torque
params.description: Torque rotational force vector.

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, torque is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

description: Applies a constant torque rotational force to a physical object. If local is TRUE, torque is applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, applied in global coordinates.

name: llSetTouchText

params.name: text
params.description: Context menu text to display.

description: Displays the string text instead of 'Touch' in the right-click context menu.

name: llSetVehicleFlags

params.name: flags
params.description: A bitwise mask of VEHICLE_FLAG_* constants to enable.

description: Enables the vehicle flags specified in the Flags bitmask.

name: llSetVehicleFloatParam

params.name: param
params.description: VEHICLE_* float parameter constant to set.

params.name: value
params.description: Float value to set.

description: Sets the specified vehicle float parameter param to value.

name: llSetVehicleRotationParam

params.name: param
params.description: VEHICLE_* rotation parameter constant to set.

params.name: rot
params.description: Rotation value to set.

description: Sets the specified vehicle rotation parameter param to rot.

name: llSetVehicleType

params.name: type
params.description: VEHICLE_TYPE_* constant to set.

description: Sets the vehicle physics preset type to one of the default vehicle types.

name: llSetVehicleVectorParam

params.name: param
params.description: VEHICLE_* vector parameter constant to set.

params.name: vec
params.description: Vector value to set.

description: Sets the specified vehicle vector parameter param to vec.

name: llSetVelocity

params.name: velocity
params.description: Linear velocity vector to apply (in meters per second).

params.name: is_local
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, velocity is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

description: Sets the linear velocity of a physical object to velocity. If local is TRUE, velocity is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, as a global region directional vector. Has no effect on non-physical objects.

name: llSHA1String

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to hash.

description: Returns a string of 40 hex characters representing the SHA-1 security hash of src.

name: llSHA256String

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to hash.

description: Returns a string of 64 hex characters representing the SHA-256 security hash of src.

name: llShout

params.name: channel
params.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to shout the message on.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to broadcast.

description: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("shout_range"), which is 100m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

name: llSignRSA

params.name: private_key
params.description: PEM-formatted private key.

params.name: msg
params.description: Message contents to sign.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Digest algorithm to use (sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512).

description: Returns the Base64-encoded RSA signature of msg using the PEM-formatted private_key and the specified digest algorithm (sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512). Can be paired with llVerifyRSA to pass verifiable messages.

name: llSin

params.name: theta
params.description: Angle in radians.

description: Returns the sine of theta. Theta is in radians.

name: llSitOnLink

params.name: agent_id
params.description: UUID of the avatar being forced to sit.

params.name: link
params.description: Link number for the prim containing the desired sit target.

description: Forces the avatar specified by agent_id (who must be participating in the experience) to sit on the sit target of the prim indicated by link. If occupied, searches down the linkset for an available sit target. Returns an integer.

name: llSitTarget

params.name: offset
params.description: Target position vector in local prim coordinates.

params.name: rot
params.description: Target rotation relative to the prim's rotation.

description: Sets the sit target position (offset) and rotation (rot) relative to the prim's position and orientation. Clears the sit target if offset is ZERO_VECTOR.

name: llSleep

params.name: sec
params.description: Duration in seconds to put the script to sleep.

description: Puts the script to sleep for sec seconds (at least until the next server-frame, ~0.02222 seconds). The script is inactive during this time. If sec is 0.0 or less, the script does not sleep.

name: llSound

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

params.name: queue
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, queues the sound; if FALSE, interrupts the currently playing sound.

params.name: loop
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, loops the sound.

description: Deprecated (use llPlaySound instead). Plays the specified sound at volume, with options to loop or queue the sound.

name: llSoundPreload

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

description: Deprecated (use llPreloadSound instead). Preloads the specified sound on viewers within range.

name: llSqrt

params.name: val
params.description: Positive float value (must be >= 0.0).

description: Returns the square root of val. If negative, return NaN.

name: llsRGB2Linear

params.name: color
params.description: Color vector in the sRGB colorspace to convert.

description: Returns a linear RGB colorspace vector converted from the sRGB colorspace argument.

name: llStartAnimation

params.name: anim
params.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, or the built-in animation name.

description: Starts the animation anim (inventory or built-in) on the avatar who granted the script the PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION permission (automatically granted for attached or sat-on objects).

name: llStartObjectAnimation

params.name: anim
params.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, or the built-in animation name.

description: Starts the specified animation anim (inventory or built-in) on the rigged mesh object associated with the current script.

name: llStopAnimation

params.name: anim
params.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, the UUID of the animation, or the built-in animation name.

description: Stops the specified animation anim (inventory, built-in, or UUID) on the avatar who granted the script the PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION permission (automatically granted for attached or sat-on objects).

name: llStopHover
description: Stops the hover behavior (such as that initiated by llSetHoverHeight).

name: llStopLookAt
description: Stops causing the object to look at or point toward a target (canceling llLookAt or llRotLookAt).

name: llStopMoveToTarget
description: Stops the critically damped movement of the object toward a target (canceling llMoveToTarget). Use llStopLookAt to stop rotational tracking.

name: llStopObjectAnimation

params.name: anim
params.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, the UUID of the animation, or the built-in animation name.

description: Stops the specified animation anim (inventory, built-in, or UUID) on the rigged mesh object associated with the current script.

name: llStopPointAt
description: Stops the avatar who owns the object from pointing.

name: llStopSound
description: Stops playback of the currently playing attached sound.

name: llStringLength

params.name: str
params.description: String to measure.

description: Returns the number of unicode codepoints in the string.

name: llStringToBase64

params.name: str
params.description: Source string to encode.

description: Returns the Base64 representation string of str, interpreting it as a UTF-8 byte sequence.

name: llStringTrim

params.name: src
params.description: String to trim.

params.name: type
params.description: Trim type flag (STRING_TRIM_HEAD, STRING_TRIM_TAIL, or STRING_TRIM).

description: Returns a copy of the string src with leading, trailing, or both types of whitespace (including spaces, tabs, and line feeds) eliminated, according to the specified trim type.

name: llSubStringIndex

params.name: source
params.description: Source string to search within.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Substring pattern to search for.

description: Returns the codepoint index of the first occurrence of pattern inside the string source. Returns -1 if not found. No regex.

name: llTakeCamera

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

description: Deprecated (use llSetCameraParams instead). Formerly used to take control of the agent's camera.

name: llTakeControls

params.name: controls
params.description: Bitfield of CONTROL_* flags to intercept.

params.name: accept
params.description: Boolean. Determines whether control events are generated to trigger script handlers.

params.name: pass_on
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, the keys also perform their default functions; if FALSE, default actions are suppressed.

description: Intercepts inputs (keyboard/mouse clicks) from the agent, specifically those specified by controls. The boolean accept determines if events are generated, and pass_on determines if inputs also perform their default functions. Requires the PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS runtime permission.

name: llTan

params.name: theta
params.description: Angle in radians.

description: Returns the tangent of theta. Theta is in radians.

name: llTarget

params.name: position
params.description: Target position vector in region coordinates.

params.name: range
params.description: Radius tolerance in meters surrounding the target position.

description: Registers a positional target at position with a leeway radius range. This triggers at_target and not_at_target events. Returns an integer handle to unregister the target via llTargetRemove.

name: llTargetedEmail

params.name: target
params.description: Target constant (e.g., TARGETED_EMAIL_OBJECT_OWNER or TARGETED_EMAIL_ROOT_CREATOR).

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: msg
params.description: Email message body.

description: Sends an email to with the given subject subject and body msg to the target (which can designate the owner or creator of the object). The email will be sent from `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`.

name: llTargetOmega

params.name: axis
params.description: Local axis vector around which the object rotates.

params.name: spinrate
params.description: Rotation rate multiplier in radians per second.

params.name: gain
params.description: A float modulating the rotational strength (disables the rotation if set to 0.0).

description: Applies a smooth client-side rotation around the local axis at a rate equal to spinrate multiplied by the magnitude of axis (in radians per second) with a force defined by gain. Set spinrate to 0.0 to cancel.

name: llTargetRemove

params.name: handle
params.description: Integer target handle returned by llTarget to remove.

description: Removes the positional target specified by the integer handle registered with llTarget.

name: llTeleportAgent

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the owning avatar to teleport.

params.name: landmark
params.description: Name of the landmark in the prim's inventory, or an empty string to teleport locally.

params.name: position
params.description: Position vector in local region coordinates to teleport to if landmark is empty.

params.name: look_at
params.description: Position vector (or direction unit vector if teleporting out of region) the agent faces upon landing.

description: Teleports the owning agent (who must grant PERMISSION_TELEPORT) to a landmark in the object's inventory. If landmark is empty, teleports them to position within the current region. Upon arrival, the agent is turned to face look_at. Can only teleport the owner.

name: llTeleportAgentGlobalCoords

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the owning avatar to teleport.

params.name: global_coordinates
params.description: Global coordinates vector of the target region (obtained via llRequestSimulatorData).

params.name: region_coordinates
params.description: Target coordinates vector within the destination region.

params.name: look_at
params.description: Position vector within the region (or unit direction vector if out of region) that the agent faces upon landing.

description: Teleports the owning agent (who must grant PERMISSION_TELEPORT) to region_coordinates within a target region specified by global_coordinates. Upon landing, the agent faces the direction look_at. Can only teleport the owner.

name: llTeleportAgentHome

params.name: avatar
params.description: UUID of the avatar to teleport.

description: Teleports the avatar (who must be standing on land owned by the script owner) directly to their designated home location without warning (similar to a God Summons).

name: llTextBox

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message to display in the text box.

params.name: channel
params.description: Output chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) where the input text is chatted.

description: Opens an input text box dialog displaying msg to the agent. Submitting text chats the input string on channel as if said by the agent. The chat originates at the object's position, but uses the agent's name and UUID, so it can be heard as long as the agent is still in the region.

name: llToLower

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to convert.

description: Returns a lowercase copy of the string src. Converts all unicode characters, not just ASCII.

name: llToUpper

params.name: src
params.description: Source string to convert.

description: Returns an uppercase copy of the string src. Converts all unicode characters, not just ASCII.

name: llTransferLindenDollars

params.name: destination
params.description: UUID of the destination avatar.

params.name: amount
params.description: Quantity of L$ to transfer (must be greater than 0).

description: Transfers amount of L$ from the script owner to the destination avatar, requiring the PERMISSION_DEBIT permission. Returns a key query handle matching the resulting transaction_result event.

name: llTransferOwnership

params.name: agent
params.description: UUID of the agent to receive ownership of the object.

params.name: flags
params.description: Flags controlling the transfer type (such as TRANSFER_FLAG_COPY or TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE).

params.name: options
params.description: Extra options applied to the transfer (currently unused).

description: Transfers ownership of the object (or a copy of it, depending on Flags) to the specified agent. Returns an integer indicating the success or failure of the transfer.

name: llTriggerSound

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

description: Plays specified sound once at volume, centered at the object's current position but not attached (does not move with the object and cannot be stopped or adjusted). Does not affect attached sounds.

name: llTriggerSoundLimited

params.name: sound
params.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

params.name: volume
params.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

params.name: top_north_east
params.description: Top-north-east boundary position vector in region coordinates.

params.name: bottom_south_west
params.description: Bottom-south-west boundary position vector in region coordinates.

description: Plays the specified sound once at volume, centered at the object but not attached, restricted to the axis-aligned bounding box defined by the coordinates top_north_east and bottom_south_west.

name: llUnescapeURL

params.name: url
params.description: Escaped URL string to decode.

description: Returns a string representing the unescaped/decoded version of url, replacing '%20' with spaces and decoding raw UTF-8 characters.

name: llUnSit

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the avatar to unsit.

description: Forces the agent specified by id to stand up if they are sitting on the object containing the script, or are currently over land owned by the object's owner.

name: llUpdateCharacter

params.name: options
params.description: A list of key-value pairs specifying the character's new configuration options (takes same constants as llCreateCharacter).

description: Updates settings for a pathfinding character using the parameters specified in options.

name: llUpdateKeyValue

params.name: k
params.description: Key of the key-value pair to update.

params.name: v
params.description: New value for the key-value pair.

params.name: checked
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, requires the existing value to match original_value to complete the update; if FALSE, creates the key if needed.

params.name: original_value
params.description: String value to compare against the existing value in the datastore.

description: Starts an asynchronous transaction to update the key k to value v inside the experience datastore. If checked is TRUE, the update fails with XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE unless the existing value matches original_value.

name: llVecDist

params.name: vec_a
params.description: First vector.

params.name: vec_b
params.description: Second vector.

description: Returns a float representing the undirected, non-negative distance between vectors vec_a and vec_b.

name: llVecMag

params.name: vec
params.description: Vector to evaluate.

description: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of vec.

name: llVecNorm

params.name: vec
params.description: Vector to normalize.

description: Returns the normalized unit vector pointing the same direction as vec. If <0, 0, 0>, return <0, 0, 0>.

name: llVerifyRSA

params.name: public_key
params.description: PEM-formatted public key to use for signature verification.

params.name: msg
params.description: Message string that was signed.

params.name: signature
params.description: Base64-encoded signature to verify.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

description: Returns TRUE if the Base64-formatted signature is verified as valid for the message msg when using the digest algorithm and public_key. Returns FALSE otherwise.

name: llVolumeDetect

params.name: detect
params.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables VolumeDetect; if FALSE (default), disables it.

description: If detect is TRUE, enables VolumeDetect (object becomes phantom and physical objects/avatars can pass through it). Triggers collision_start on initial intersection and collision_end when intersection stops (standard collision events are suppressed while intersecting).

name: llWanderWithin

params.name: origin
params.description: Center coordinate position vector to wander about.

params.name: dist
params.description: A vector specifying the maximum distance limits (half-extents) along each world-aligned axis from the origin.

params.name: options
params.description: A list of WANDER_* flags and parameters to configure the wander behavior.

description: Directs a pathfinding character to wander around a central coordinate origin, restricted within the bounding distance limits of dist and configured by options.

name: llWater

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a float representing the water height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llWhisper

params.name: channel
params.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to whisper the message on.

params.name: msg
params.description: Text message string to broadcast.

description: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("whisper_range"), which is 10m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

name: llWind

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

description: Returns a vector representing the wind velocity at the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

name: llWorldPosToHUD

params.name: world_pos
params.description: World-frame position vector to project into HUD space.

description: Returns the local position vector that places the center of the HUD object directly over the world coordinate world_pos as viewed by the current camera. Requires the PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA runtime permission.

name: llXorBase64

params.name: str1
params.description: First Base64 string.

params.name: str2
params.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

description: Correctly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2, returning the result as a Base64 string. The string str2 repeats if it is shorter than str1.

name: llXorBase64Strings

params.name: str1
params.description: First Base64 string.

params.name: str2
params.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

description: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Retained for backwards compatibility. Incorrectly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

name: llXorBase64StringsCorrect

params.name: str1
params.description: First Base64 string.

params.name: str2
params.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

description: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Correctly performs (unless nulls are present) a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

name: botAddTag
description: Adds a tag "tag" to the bot with the ID "botID". This allows you to keep track of multiple bots with the bot tag commands and apply actions to all of them at the same time. botID - ID of the bot that the tag will be added to tag - a string identifier that will be applied to the bot Example: bot Tag Removal.lsl bot Tagged Removal.lsl bot Tagging.lsl See Also: botRemoveTag, botGetBotsWithTag, botRemoveBotsWithTag

name: botChangeOutfit
description: Changes the bot's appearance to be wearing the outfit retrieved from the database with the given outfit name. botID - ID of the bot that will be changing appearance. outfitName - name of the outfit that the bot will begin wearing. Example: bot Change Outfit.lsl See Also: botSetOutfit botRemoveOutfit, botGetBotOutfits

name: botCreateBot
description: Creates a bot in the world with name "firstName" "lastName" at position "startPosition" wearing the outfit with the name "outfitName". Returns the key of the newly-created bot. firstName - first name to be given to the bot lastName - last name to be given to the bot outfitName - outfit that the bot will be wearing startPosition - location that the bot will be created at options - options that will be set to the bot This can be set to the following constants: BOT_CREATE_DEFAULT - Creates the bot with the script owner as the owner of the bot

name: botDeregisterFromCollisionEvents
description: Deregisters the object group the script is in from forwarded collision events. botID - ID of the bot that will stop forwarding collision events. Example: bot Collision Events.lsl See Also: botRegisterForCollisionEvents

name: botDeregisterFromNavigationEvents
description: Deregisters the script from bot_update events that were previously set by botRegisterToCollisionEvents. botID - ID of the bot that will stop forwarding on bot_update events. Example: bot Navigation Event Registration.lsl See Also: botRegisterForNavigationEvents

name: botFollowAvatar
description: Causes a bot with the ID "botID" to begin following the user "avatar" in the sim. Returns whether the operation was successful and error conditions. botID - ID of the bot who will begin following the avatar. avatar - ID (key) of the user that the bot will begin following. options - options that will affect how the bot follows the avatar. This can contain the following keys: BOT_ALLOW_RUNNING - whether the bot is allowed to run while attempting to follow the user. Takes TRUE or FALSE as valid values. BOT_ALLOW_FLYING - whether the bot is allowed to fly while attempting to follow the user. Takes TRUE or FALSE as valid values. BOT_ALLOW_JUMPING - whether the bot is allowed to jump while attempting to follow the user. Takes TRUE or FALSE as valid values. BOT_FOLLOW_OFFSET - an offset away from the user's position that the bot will attempt to move to instead of directly on top of the user. Takes a vector parameter that is the offset away from the user. BOT_REQUIRES_LINE_OF_SIGHT - will only follow the avatar if there are no objects in-between the bot and the avatar. Takes TRUE or FALSE as valid values. BOT_START_FOLLOWING_DISTANCE - the distance before the bot will begin moving after the avatar once the bot has gotten to the avatar and stopped. Takes a float that is the distance that the avatar will need to move away from the bot before the bot will start following the avatar again. BOT_STOP_FOLLOWING_DISTANCE - the distance before the bot will stop moving closer to the avatar. Takes a float that is the distance that the bot will stop moving closer to the avatar when the bot is attempting to move closer to the user. BOT_LOST_AVATAR_DISTANCE - the distance before the bot gives up attempting to follow the avatar and triggers the bot_update event with the lost avatar parameter. Takes a float that is the distance that the bot has to be away from the user before the bot will give up attempting to follow the user. Return values: This function will return one of the following return codes: BOT_SUCCESS - The bot is now successfully following the avatar. BOT_NOT_FOUND - The bot with the given ID was not found in the sim. BOT_USER_NOT_FOUND - The user with the givne ID was not found in the sim. BOT_ERROR - A generic error occured, an input into the function was not correct. Example: bot Follow Avatar.lsl

name: botGetAllBotsInRegion
description: Returns a list containing the keys of all bots in the sim regardless of who owns them. Example: bot Remove all bots.lsl See Also: botGetAllMyBotsInRegion

name: botGetAllMyBotsInRegion
description: Returns a list containing the keys of all bots in the sim that the script owner controls. Example: bot Remove all my bots.lsl See Also: botGetAllBotsInRegion

name: botGetBotOutfits
description: Returns a list of strings representing all outfit names that have been stored into the database by the script owner. Example: bot Outfit Manager.lsl See Also: botSetOutfit, botRemoveOutfit, botChangeOutfit

name: botGetBotsWithTag
description: Returns a list of all bot IDs (keys) that have a given tag "tag" applied to them. tag - Tag that all bots in the returned list will have Example: bot Tag Removal.lsl bot Tagged Removal.lsl bot Tagging.lsl See Also: botAddTag, botRemoveTag, botRemoveBotsWithTag

name: botGetName
description: Returns the name of the bot with the ID "botID". botID - ID of the bot whose name will be returned. Example: bot Information.lsl

name: botGetOwner
description: Returns the ID (key) of the user that owns the bot, or NULL_KEY if the bot is not currently owned by any user or the bot cannot be found. botID - ID of the bot whose owner will be returned. Example: bot Information.lsl

name: botGetPos
description: Returns the current position of the bot with the ID "botID". botID - ID of the bot whose position will be returned. Example: bot Information.lsl

name: botGetProfileParams
description: Returns a list of string values corresponding to the specified bot profile fields. botID - ID of the bot whose profile will be updated. profileInformation - list of constants representing which profile values will be returned in the same order Values can be any of the following: BOT_ABOUT_TEXT - the about text BOT_EMAIL - the profile email BOT_IMAGE_UUID - the main profile image BOT_PROFILE_URL - the profile URL. Returns a list of strings corresponding to the requested bot profile fields. Returned values are in the same order as the keys in profileInformation. Example: bot Profile Information.lsl

name: botGiveObject
description: Causes the bot with the given ID "botID" to send the inventory item with the name "inventory" to the user whose key is "destination". Bots can only give inventory items to other users in the sim. botID - ID of the bot who will give the object to the user destination - ID of the user in the sim who will receive the inventory item. inventory - name of the inventory item that will be sent to the user Example: bot Give Object.lsl

name: botIsBot
description: Returns TRUE if the ID "userID" is the key of a bot and FALSE if a bot does not exist with the given ID. userID - ID that will be checked whether a bot exists with the given ID. Example: bot Information.lsl

name: botListen
description: Returns the listen handle for msg on channel from name and id at the position of the bot whose ID is botID. botID - ID of the bot who will begin listening channel - input chat channel name - filter for specific prim or avatar name id - filter for specific avatar or prim key message - filter for a specific message Example: bot Listening.lsl See Also: llListenRemove

name: botMessageLinked
description: Causes a link_message event to be triggered in all attachments of the bot with the given information. botID - ID of the bot whose attachments will get the link_message event. num - numeric parameter to send to the specified bot attachments. msg - string parameter to send to the specified bot attachments. id - key parameter to send to the specified bot attachments. Example: bot Message Linked.lsl See Also: llMessageLinked, linked_message

name: botPauseMovement
description: Pauses any movement that the bot currently has until botResumeMovement is called. botID - ID of the bot that will be paused. Example: bot Navigation Path.lsl

name: botRegisterForCollisionEvents
description: Registers the object group the script is in for collision events from the bot with the ID "botID". All collision, collision_start, collision_end, land_collision, land_collision_start, and land_collision_end are forwarded to all scripts in the given object. botID - ID of the bot that will begin forwarding collision events to the object. Example: bot Collision Events.lsl See Also: botDeregisterFromCollisionEvents

name: botRegisterForNavigationEvents
description: Causes the script to receive bot_update events for the given bot with the ID "botID" if the script is not already receiving this event (the script the bot is created in automatically receives bot_update). botID - ID of the bot who will forward on future bot_update events. Example: bot Navigation Event Registration.lsl See Also: botDeregisterFromNavigationEvents

name: botRemoveBot
description: Removes a bot with the given ID "botID" from the sim. botID - ID of the bot that will be removed from the sim. Example: bot Creation.lsl

name: botRemoveBotsWithTag
description: Removes all bots from the sim that have the given tag "tag". tag - Tag that all bots that will be removed have Example: bot Tag Removal.lsl bot Tagged Removal.lsl bot Tagging.lsl See Also: botAddTag, botRemoveTag, botGetBotsWithTag

name: botRemoveOutfit
description: Removes the given outfit name from the database (this will be done automatically after 6 months of inactivity on the outfit if it is not used). outfitName - the outfit name that will be removed from the database. Example: bot Outfit Manager.lsl See Also: botSetOutfit, botChangeOutfit, botGetBotOutfits

name: botRemoveTag
description: Removes a tag "tag" from the bot with the ID "botID". This allows you to keep track of multiple bots with the bot tag commands and apply actions to all of them at the same time. botID - ID of the bot that the tag will be removed from tag - a string identifier that will be removed from the bot if it is applied Example: bot Tag Removal.lsl bot Tagged Removal.lsl bot Tagging.lsl See Also: botAddTag, botGetBotsWithTag, botRemoveBotsWithTag

name: botResumeMovement
description: Resumes any movement that the bot had before botPauseMovement was called. botID - ID of the bot whose movement will be resumed. Example: bot Navigation Path.lsl

name: botSay
description: The bot that has the ID "botID" will say the message "message" on channel "channel". botID - ID of the bot that will be talking. channel - output chat channel, any integer value message - message to be transmitted Example: bot Chat.lsl See Also: botWhisper, botShout, botStartTyping, botStopTyping, botSendInstantMessage, botListen

name: botSendInstantMessage
description: The bot with the given ID "botID" will send an instant message to the user "userID" with the given message "message". botID - ID of the bot that will send the instant message userID - ID of the user that will receive the instant message. message - message to be transmitted to the user Caveats: The user that the instant message is being sent to must be in the same sim as the bot. Example: bot Instant Messaging.lsl See Also: botWhisper, botSay, botShout, botStartTyping, botStopTyping, botListen

name: botSensor
description: Performs a single scan from the position of the bot for name and id with type within range meters and arc radians of forward vector. botID - ID of the bot whose position will be used for the sensor. name - object or avatar name. id - avatar or object UUID that is in the same region. type - mask (AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, and/or SCRIPTED). range - range from 0.0 to 96.0. arc - the max angle between the local x-axis of the prim and detectable objects, range 0.0 to PI. Example: bot Sensor Commands.lsl See Also: botSensorRepeat, botSensorRemove, sensor event, no_sensor event

name: botSensorRemove
description: Removes the bot sensor set up by botSensorRepeat. Example: bot Sensor Commands.lsl See Also: botSensor, botSensorRepeat, sensor event, no_sensor event

name: botSensorRepeat
description: Performs a single scan from the position of the bot for name and id with type within range meters and arc radians of forward vector and repeats every rate seconds. It does not perform the first scan until rate seconds have passed. botID - ID of the bot whose position will be used for the sensor. name - object or avatar name. id - avatar or object UUID that is in the same region. type - mask (AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, and/or SCRIPTED). range - range from 0.0 to 96.0. arc - the max angle between the local x-axis of the prim and detectable objects, range 0.0 to PI. rate - how often a sensor/no_sensor will be queued. Example: bot Sensor Commands.lsl See Also: botSensor, botSensorRemove, sensor event, no_sensor event

name: botSetMovementSpeed
description: Changes the speed multiplier to "speedMultiplier" of the bot with the ID "botID". speedMultiplier - a float between 0.0 and the 100.0 that will change the speed multiplier of the bot. 0.0 is no movement, 1.0 is normal speed, 2.0 is twice the speed, etc. botID - ID of the bot whose speed multiplier will be changed. Example: bot Movement Speed.lsl

name: botSetNavigationPoints
description: Causes the bot with the ID "botID" to begin navigating along the given path. botID - ID of the bot that will begin navigating the path. positions - list of positions that the bot will be navigating along. This can contain both vector positions to move around and float values that specify wait times (in seconds). If a vector is specified, the corresponding position in the movementTypes list must NOT be BOT_TRAVELMODE_WAIT. If a float is specified, the corresponding position in the movementTypes list must be BOT_TRAVELMODE_WAIT. movementTypes - list of modes of travel that the bot will utilize when moving between the given positions. The valid values are BOT_TRAVELMODE_WALK, BOT_TRAVELMODE_RUN, BOT_TRAVELMODE_FLY, BOT_TRAVELMODE_TELEPORT, and BOT_TRAVELMODE_WAIT. options - options that will specify how the bot will move between positions. This can contain the following keys: BOT_MOVEMENT_TYPE - sets whether the bot will stop moving at the end of the position list or whether the bot will go back to the beginning of the list and re-traverse the position list. Valid values are: BOT_MOVEMENT_FLAG_NONE - the bot will stop moving once all positions in the list have been moved to. BOT_MOVEMENT_FLAG_FOLLOW_INDEFINITELY - follow the list indefinitely until the bot's movement is stopped by botStopMovement. BOT_MOVEMENT_TELEPORT_AFTER - the amount of time (in seconds) that the bot will be allowed to be stuck while attempting to move to the next position in the list before teleporting to the position it is attempting to move to. Takes a float that is the number of seconds to wait before teleporting to the next position node. Example: bot Navigation Path.lsl

name: botSetOutfit
description: Causes the current appearance of the script owner to be saved to the database with the given outfit name so that it can later be used by botCreateBot to set the initial appearance of the bot or botChangeOutfit to change the outfit of a bot at a later time. outfitName - the name of the outfit that will be used later to refer to the current appearance of the script owner. Example: bot Outfit Manager.lsl See Also: botRemoveOutfit, botChangeOutfit, botGetBotOutfits

name: botSetProfileParams
description: Sets information about the bot's profile. botID - ID of the bot whose profile will be updated. profileInformation - list of params that contains a key and then a value that will update the bot's profile information. Valid keys are BOT_ABOUT_TEXT - sets the about text BOT_EMAIL - sets the profile email BOT_IMAGE_UUID - sets the main profile image BOT_PROFILE_URL - sets the profile URL Example: bot Profile Information.lsl

name: botSetRotation
description: Sets the rotation of the bot with the ID "botID" to the rotation "rot". botID - ID of the bot whose rotation will be modified. rot - new final rotation of the bot if it is possible to rotate the bot in that manner. Example: bot Set Rotation.lsl

name: botShout
description: The bot that has the ID "botID" will shout the message "message" on channel "channel". botID - ID of the bot that will be shouting. channel - output chat channel, any integer value message - message to be transmitted Example: bot Chat.lsl See Also: botWhisper, botSay, botStartTyping, botStopTyping, botSendInstantMessage, botListen

name: botSitObject
description: Causes a bot with the given ID "botID" to sit on the object with the ID "objectID". botID - ID of the bot that will sit on the object. objectID - ID of the object that the bot will sit on. Example: bot Sitting on Objects.lsl See Also: botStandUp

name: botStandUp
description: Causes the bot with the given ID "botID" to stand up if the bot is sitting. botID - ID of the bot that will stand up. Example: bot Sitting on Objects.lsl See Also: botSitObject

name: botStartAnimation
description: Causes the bot with the ID "botID" to begin playing an animation with the name or UUID "animation". botID - ID of the bot who will begin playing an animation. animation - an item in the inventory of the prim with the script is in or a built-in animation. Example: bot Animation.lsl See Also: botStopAnimation

name: botStartTyping
description: The bot that has the ID "botID" will begin the typing animation and play the typing sound. botID - ID of the bot that will start typing. Example: bot Typing.lsl See Also: botWhisper, botSay, botShout, botStopTyping, botSendInstantMessage, botListen

name: botStopAnimation
description: Causes the bot with the ID "botID" to stop playing an animation with the name or UUID "animation". botID - ID of the bot who will stop playing an animation. animation - an item in the inventory of the prim with the script is in or a built-in animation. Example: bot Animation.lsl See Also: botStartAnimation

name: botStopMovement
description: Causes the bot to cease all movement that could have resulted from following an avatar, navigating a path, or wandering. botID - ID of the bot who will stop moving. Example: bot Stop Movement.lsl

name: botStopTyping
description: The bot that has the ID "botID" will stop playing the typing animation and stop playing the typing sound. botID - ID of the bot that will stop typing. Example: bot Typing.lsl See Also: botWhisper, botSay, botShout, botStartTyping, botSendInstantMessage, botListen

name: botTeleportTo
description: Causes the bot with the ID "botID" to teleport to a new position "newPosition" within the current region. botID - ID of the bot who will teleport to a new location. newPosition - position in the sim that the bot will teleport to. Example: bot Teleport To.lsl

name: botTouchObject
description: Causes the bot with the given ID "botID" to touch an object with the ID "objectID". botID - ID of the bot that will touch an object objectID - ID of the object that the bot will touch. Example: bot Touch Object.lsl

name: botWanderWithin
description: Causes the bot to wander randomly within the area contained around the origin "origin" by "xDistance" away from the origin along the x-axis and by "yDistance" away from the origin along the y-axis. botID - ID of the bot that will begin wandering. origin - position that the wandering will revolve around. xDistance - distance that the bot is able to wander away from the origin in the x direction. yDistance - distance that the bot is able to wander away from the origin in the y direction. options - options that will affect how the bot will wander around. This can contain the following keys BOT_WANDER_MOVEMENT_TYPE - Sets the form of movement that the bot will utilize to wander around The valid parameters for this are BOT_TRAVELMODE_WALK BOT_TRAVELMODE_RUN BOT_TRAVELMODE_FLY BOT_TRAVELMODE_TELEPORT BOT_WANDER_TIME_BETWEEN_NODES - Sets the amoutn of time that the bot will wait (in seconds) before moving onto the next position. Takes a float as the secondary parameter. Example: bot Wander Within.lsl

name: botWhisper
description: The bot that has the ID "botID" will whisper the message "message" on channel "channel". botID - ID of the bot that will be whispering. channel - output chat channel, any integer value message - message to be transmitted Example: bot Chat.lsl See Also: botSay, botShout, botStartTyping, botStopTyping, botSendInstantMessage, botListen

name: iwDetectedBot
description: Returns a key that is the UUID of the bot that triggered this event. Example: bot Sensor Commands.lsl

name: iwRezAt
review: parameter 'out int sleepTime' has no LSL form
